title: Manager - Revenue Management
description:
Job Title: Manager – Revenue Management
   

  

**Role Highlights / Summary**
 Revenue Management – Manager shall be tasked with developing and maximizing the revenue opportunities for the airline. The role requires strong analytical skills and ability to deliver expected unit revenues in a highly competitive market scenario.
   

  

**Typical Interfaces**
* Sales Team
* Network Planning
* Pricing \& Revenue Management Teams
* Commercial \& Strategy Teams
* External market/industry stakeholders


**Key Responsibility**
* Optimize Revenue on assigned flights
* Meet monthly Revenue and Passenger Revenue per Available Seat Kilometers (PRASK) target.
* Inventory positioning on assigned flights based on demand and seasonal patterns.
* Monitor and adjust fares based on market inputs and demand, ensure IndiGo offers competitive fare.
* Coordination with sales teams and other stakeholders to understand the market scenario and position IndiGo's fare accordingly.
* Manage demand forecast by analyzing historical and future trends on assigned flights to ensure revenue maximization.
* Ensure that overbooking is economically viable.
* Utilize IndiGo’s RM systems to drive optimized revenue and calibrate system inputs to have optimized results.
* Comprehensive reporting of competitor activity.


**Tools \& Resources**
* Revenue Management Systems (RMS)
* MS Excel
* Power BI / Data Visualization Tools
* Internal pricing and analytics tools


**Required Skills**
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills
* Understanding of airline pricing, forecasting, and inventory control
* Advanced Excel and reporting capability
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, competitive environment
* Stakeholder coordination and communication


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Minimum Graduate Required
* 8\-12 years of relevant experience in Revenue Management
* Experience with pricing, demand forecasting, and airline metrics


 Location \& Work Mode
   

  

* Location: Gurgaon
* Work Mode: Work From Office, all 5 days Mandatory


 At IndiGo, we believe in the innate strength of an energetic, diverse, and inclusive workforce, where the viewpoints and life experiences of our employees help us foster strong connections with all our customers.

title: Industrial Training - Finance (Regulatory Reporting)
description:
**OAKNORTH**
**Industrial Training – Regulatory Reporting**
 Finance
   

  

* Regulatory Reporting


 📍 India \| 🕐 Internship (12 months) \| 🏢 Onsite \| 🎯 Intern
   

  

**About Us**
 At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Regulatory Reporting team is responsible for producing accurate, timely, and complete regulatory and management reporting across liquidity, capital, credit, and balance sheet returns for OakNorth Bank. We work closely with Treasury, Finance, and Risk to ensure the Bank meets its obligations to the PRA, Bank of England, and other regulators — while continuously improving the quality and efficiency of our reporting processes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Intern to join our Regulatory Reporting and Treasury team for a 9\-month placement, with an immediate start. You'll support the production of a broad range of regulatory returns — including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet\-driven submissions — alongside management information and treasury ALCO packs. This is an excellent opportunity for a recently qualified finance professional to gain hands\-on exposure to regulatory reporting in a fast\-paced banking environment.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Support production of monthly and quarterly liquidity returns including NSFR, LCR, ALMM, and PRA110, with reconciliation to financials.
* Assist with balance sheet\-driven regulatory returns including FINREP, PRA108, and Bank of England statistical returns (BT, ELS, GT, AD, AL, BE, CC, PL).
* Contribute to additional exposure\-related returns including FSA015, PRA loan book data, asset encumbrance, and mortgage returns (MLAR).
* Support capital and RWA reporting including own funds, credit exposure returns, leverage ratio, and large exposures.
* Assist in the preparation of pre\-defined and ad hoc management information as directed by the manager.
* Support production of treasury ALCO packs.
* Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all reporting; highlight gaps or errors in processes or logic and actively contribute to improvements.
* Support the Pillar 3 document publication process and assist with stress testing, ICAAP, and ILAAP activities.


**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**
* CA intermediate cleared and Article ship completed from a reputed firm.
* A strong foundation in financial and accounting concepts, with an interest in regulatory reporting and treasury functions.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and completeness in all work produced.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines simultaneously.
* A proactive approach to identifying and resolving process gaps, with a continuous improvement mindset.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior exposure to regulatory reporting frameworks such as PRA, Bank of England returns, or Basel III metrics.
* Familiarity with liquidity and capital concepts including LCR, NSFR, or RWA calculations.
* Experience working with financial data in Excel or other reporting tools.

title: Manager, Finance Operations
description:
**Description**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
**Footer**
 Overall Purpose of The Job
   

  

 The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day\-to\-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India — booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well\-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function.
   

  

**Key RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Own the end\-to\-end booking\-to\-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds.
* Oversee high\-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release.
* Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms.
* Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass\-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees.
* Own the month\-end and year\-end close for the Finance Operations sub\-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger.
* Prepare and review unit\-level and product\-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan.
* Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership.
* Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs
* Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs).
* Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team.
* Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR\-2B mismatches with vendors.
* Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross\-border settlements.
* Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection.
* Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation
* Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness
* Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent\-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle


**Key Metrics / Success Measures**
* Timely and accurate operational close: sub\-ledger close completed within 4\-5 business days of month\-end with zero material post\-close adjustments.
* Payment discipline: on\-time payment rate of \[≥ 98%] and DPO within targeted range.
* BSP, gateway and agent\-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month.
* Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR\-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations.
* Accurate and timely unit\-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence.


 Job Profile
   

  

**Requirements**
* 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team.
* Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations
* Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools.
* Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage.
* Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross\-border payments).
* Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass\-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically.
* High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics.
* Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience.
* Chartered Accountant (Mandatory).


**Required Languages**
* Good spoken and written English language skills


**Travel Requirements**
* Not applicable / minimal.

**Team**
 You’ll be part of a professional and collaborative team where precision and accountability are valued. The Close\-to\-Report (CTR) team manages month\-end and year\-end close activities ensuring accurate, transparent and timely preparation and presentation of our financial statements.
   

  

**Role**
 As our new Senior Associate in CTR, you will support timely and accurate bank reconciliations and intercompany reporting in line with GAAP/IFRS. Your role will involve preparing financial data, reconciling transactions and balances, and supporting intercompany settlements, ensuring the integrity of our financial close process.
   

  

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**

* Maintain an up\-to\-date register of group companies and related party transactions
* Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjustments
* Support relevant month\-end, quarter\-end and year\-end close activities

* Ensure comprehensive documentation and strict adherence to internal policies and controls and SOX compliance requirements

* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel with demonstrated ability in financial modeling, data analysis, and troubleshooting complex accounting issues
* Collaborative colleague with ability to perform under tight deadlines while consistently maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency
* Proficient in ERP systems (like MSBC) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)
* Proficient verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Background in PE or fund management would be considered as an added advantage
* Professional qualifications like CA/CPA/ACCA qualifications will be preferred.


**The process**
 Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
   

  

 As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
   

  

 Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

 CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
   

  

 A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

 CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy\-period \- supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large\-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M\&A.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Supply Chain Manager
 



  





 About Lyor
 



 Lyor provides fully furnished, professionally managed rental homes and furniture rentals. We manufacture much of our furniture in\-house and manage the installation, maintenance and movement of assets across multiple apartments. As we scale, we're hiring a hands\-on Manager \- Supply Chain \& Asset Control to own this end to end.
 



  





 The role
 



 You'll run the supply chain for Lyor Homes and furniture rentals: purchasing, stock control, asset movements and apartment asset registers. Our Odoo setup is still evolving, so you'll identify gaps and help define the right workflow \- not only operate an established ERP.
 



  





 Day in the life
 



 This is a hands\-on role. On a typical office day, you will:
 



 \- Start with the supply plan: review upcoming apartment installations, furniture rental deliveries and maintenance replacements. Check what is available, what is reserved, what the factory will deliver and what must be purchased.
 



 \- Set priorities for the team: assign purchase follow\-ups, receiving, dispatches and stock checks. Resolve shortages before they delay an installation.
 



 \- Coordinate across teams: speak with design on specifications and substitutions, the factory on deliveries, and the projects team on site readiness and installation dates.
 



 \- Control purchases and movements: review purchase orders and delivery commitments. Check that items received, transferred or dispatched are recorded against the correct location in Odoo.
 



 \- Investigate discrepancies: compare apartment asset sheets with dispatch and installation records. Follow up on missing, damaged or wrongly allocated items until records and physical position match.
 



 \- Close the day with clear information: confirm the next day's deliveries and dispatches, update unresolved issues with owners and dates, and report any risk to an apartment handover.
 



  





 You'll also spend time at the factory, store and apartments verifying records against physical assets \- managing today's work while improving the process, so purchases, stock levels and apartment assets no longer depend on people's memory. The daily output is simple: the team knows what is needed next, where each asset is, what is delayed, and who is resolving every discrepancy.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 \- Hands\-on experience across procurement, inventory control and movement of physical assets across multiple locations
 



 \- You've built or improved a process in a growing business \- experience only within a mature, fully configured ERP won't be sufficient
 



 \- Strong Excel skills and working ERP experience; Odoo preferred
 



 \- You can reconcile system records with physical items, trace discrepancies and follow them through to closure
 



 \- Strong planning, vendor follow\-up and communication skills, with willingness to visit sites and verify work personally
 



 \- Furniture rental, serviced apartments, hospitality, retail fit\-outs, appliances or equipment rental backgrounds are all relevant
 



 \- Supply chain degree welcome, not mandatory
 



  





 What success looks like
 



 Every new apartment has an accurate, verified asset register at handover. Stock availability and reservations are visible to the team. Purchases and dispatches are planned ahead \- and every asset movement can be traced without relying on one person's memory.
 



  





 Details
 



 Delhi NCR (regular visits to our Okhla factory, stores and apartments)
 



 Reporting to: Founder / COO
 



 Experience: \~6\-10 years \| On\-site

title: Country Office Accountant
company: ICARDA; International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas
description:
**Reports to:** 
 Head of Finance
 **Location:** 
 New Delhi, India
   

  

**Purpose of the position**
 The Country Office Accountant will support the effective financial management and accounting operations of ICARDA's India Country Office and ensure that financial transactions are accurately recorded, properly supported, and processed in accordance with ICARDA policies and procedures.
   

  

 The position will have responsibility for local tax and statutory compliance, coordination with chartered accountants and auditors, financial reconciliations, statutory reporting, and maintaining accurate and audit\-ready financial records.
   

  

 The incumbent will work closely with ICARDA HQ Finance, Grant Finance, HR, Procurement, Administration, external auditors, chartered accountants, tax advisers, banks, and other relevant stakeholders.
   

  

**About ICARDA**
 The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) is a treaty\-based international non\-profit research organization supported by CGIAR.
   

  

 ICARDA's mission is to reduce poverty, enhance food, water, and nutritional security, as well as environmental health in the face of global challenges including climate change. We do this through innovative science, strategic partnerships, linking research to development and capacity development that take into account gender equality and the role of youth in transforming the dry areas. ICARDA works in partnership with governments, universities, civil society, national agricultural research organization, other CGIAR Research Centers, and the private sector. With its temporary Headquarters in Beirut, Lebanon, ICARDA operates in regional and country offices across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. For more information: www.icarda.org.
   

  

 Main responsibilities
   

  

**Finance Operations**
* Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions based on appropriate supporting documentation and authorization and in compliance with ICARDA policies, procedures, and established practices
* Ensure that account balances are accurate, properly supported, and proactively managed
* Review accounts receivable and accounts payable at least twice a month and follow up on outstanding balances and unreconciled items
* Assist the Grant Finance Officer in preparing accurate, timely, and verifiable financial reports for donors
* Organize and perform monthly and annual financial closing activities in coordination with HQ Finance and in accordance with established procedures and deadlines
* Prepare monthly cash and bank reconciliations and ensure timely investigation and clearance of reconciling items
* Review and analyze General Ledger accounts and initiate necessary corrections and adjustments
* Support HQ Finance in monthly, quarterly, and annual closing and reporting activities, with responsibility for accounting matters relating to the India Country Office
* Assist HQ Finance in maintaining an accurate and up\-to\-date fixed asset register for assets located in India and support periodic physical verification
* Maintain complete, accurate, and properly organized financial records and supporting documentation
* Ensure effective cash management and timely and accurate processing of payments in accordance with ICARDA's internal controls and delegated authorities
* Regularly monitor petty cash and ICARDA India bank accounts, including local and foreign currency accounts, and coordinate banking matters as required
* Prepare monthly cashflow and expenditure projections for submission to HQ and monitor actual utilization against projections


**Tax and Statutory Compliance**
* Coordinate and monitor ICARDA India's compliance with applicable Indian tax, statutory, and financial reporting requirements in coordination with HQ Finance and appointed professional advisers
* Maintain an up\-to\-date compliance calendar covering applicable tax and statutory filing, payment, certification, and reporting deadlines
* Coordinate the preparation, review, payment, filing, reconciliation, and documentation of applicable local taxes and statutory obligations, including income tax/TDS, GST, payroll\-related taxes and statutory contributions, and other applicable taxes or levies
* Ensure taxes deducted or collected are correctly calculated, recorded, reconciled, paid, and reported within applicable statutory deadlines
* Perform regular reconciliation of tax and statutory accounts against the General Ledger, tax returns, payments, certificates, and other supporting records
* Review transactions from a local tax\-compliance perspective and identify potential implications relating to withholding tax, GST, employee taxation, vendor taxation, and other applicable requirements
* Coordinate with HR, Procurement, Administration, HQ Finance, and other functions to obtain information and documentation required for statutory compliance
* Liaise with ICARDA's chartered accountants, tax advisers, banks, and relevant statutory authorities on routine finance and compliance matters, as authorized
* Maintain complete documentation of tax returns, statutory filings, payment receipts, tax certificates, assessments, notices, reconciliations, and related correspondence
* Promptly escalate significant tax exposures, statutory notices, penalties, disputed positions, or potential non\-compliance to HQ Finance and management


**Audit and Assurance**
* Coordinate the preparation of financial information, schedules, reconciliations, supporting documentation, and confirmations required for statutory, external, internal, and donor audits relating to ICARDA India
* Act as the local Finance focal point for chartered accountants and auditors, in coordination with HQ Finance
* Ensure timely and complete responses to audit queries and requests
* Maintain financial records in an audit\-ready condition and ensure transactions can be traced from the General Ledger to supporting documentation, approvals, payments, and applicable tax records
* Maintain and follow up on audit findings, tax observations, management recommendations, and agreed corrective actions until closure
* Support implementation of recommendations arising from statutory audits, internal audits, donor audits, and tax reviews


 Contribute to strengthening financial controls and procedures where audit findings, changes in legislation, or operational developments identify compliance or control risks.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Education, qualifications, and experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline
* Professional accounting qualification or progress toward a recognized qualification such as CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent would be an advantage
* Relevant professional experience in accounting, financial management, tax compliance, and audit support, preferably within an international organization, research institution, development organization, NGO, or similar environment
* Practical knowledge and experience with Indian taxation and statutory compliance, particularly TDS/income tax, GST, payroll\-related statutory requirements, and applicable filing and payment procedures
* Experience working with chartered accountants, tax advisers, statutory auditors, and external auditors
* Experience with General Ledger accounting, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliations, financial closing, and financial reporting
* Experience using ERP/accounting systems and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Experience supporting donor\-funded projects and donor financial reporting would be an advantage


**Benefits**
 Terms of appointment, salary, and benefits
   

  

 This is a nationally recruited position open to Indian nationals for which ICARDA offers an attractive compensation package including a competitive salary, medical insurance, 30 days of annual leave, five months' maternity leave, 15 days' paternity leave. The successful candidate will be offered an initial contract of 3 years, renewable subject to continued need for the position and satisfactory performance. The first year will be probationary period.
   

  

**Please be advised that ICARDA accepts applications only in English, as per the organization's standard communication language. Applications in other languages will not be considered.**
**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
About The Company
 



 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
 



 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
 



 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
 



 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
 



 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
 



 About The Role
 



 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney's existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
 



 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
 



 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
 



 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Own NPV \& Unit Economics:** 
 Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation
* **Measure Expected vs Actual Performance:** 
 Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions
* **Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution:** 
 Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped
* **Influence Business Decisions:** 
 Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them
* **Embed NPV in Decision\-Making:** 
 Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline
* **Raise the Analytical Bar:** 
 Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney's mission of providing responsible access to credit


**Requirements**

 Must\-Haves
 


* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors)
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action



 Nice\-To\-Have
 


* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests)
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams



 What Success Looks Like
 


**By Month 3**
* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control


**By Month 6**
* NPV actively drives decisions on:


* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions



 Final Note
 



 This is not a passive analytics role.
 



 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
 



 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  




**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure



**Recruitment Process:** 



* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team
* Technical interview with the hiring manager
* Case study round
* Panel session based on the case study

description:
**About Us.**

**Role Overview** 




  






 We're looking for a Credit Analyst with strong functional expertise in credit underwriting to work closely with our product development team. This is not a traditional underwriting desk role you'll act as the functional/domain expert embedded with engineers, product managers, and business analysts to help design, validate, and refine a credit underwriting product. Your job is to translate real\-world underwriting practices, policies, and edge cases into product requirements and logic the team can build.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Act as the subject matter expert (SME) on credit underwriting for the product development team, bridging the gap between business/functional needs and technical implementation
* Define and document underwriting workflows, credit assessment criteria, scoring logic, and decisioning rules to be built into the product
* Review credit policies, RBI/regulatory guidelines, and industry underwriting standards, and translate them into functional specifications
* Work with product managers and business analysts to create user stories, process flows, and business requirement documents (BRDs) related to underwriting
* Validate system outputs, test underwriting logic/rules engines, and identify gaps or inconsistencies versus real\-world lending practice
* Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by designing test cases based on real credit scenarios (income assessment, risk scoring, collateral evaluation, financial ratio analysis, etc.)
* Provide inputs on credit risk parameters financial statement analysis, cash flow assessment, credit bureau data (CIBIL/Experian/Equifax), ratio analysis, banking behavior, etc.
* Stay updated on lending products (secured/unsecured loans, working capital, term loans, etc.) to ensure the product supports varied underwriting scenarios

**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




  




* 7–8 years of experience in credit underwriting/credit analysis, preferably across retail, SME, or corporate lending
* Strong functional knowledge of underwriting processes  income assessment, credit bureau analysis, ratio analysis, risk scoring, and credit policy frameworks
* Hands\-on experience with loan origination systems (LOS), loan management systems (LMS), or credit underwriting platforms
* Experience writing BRDs/FSDs or working closely with product/tech teams (prior exposure to Agile/Scrum environments preferred)
* Good understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in lending (RBI guidelines, KYC/AML basics, etc.)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business logic into structured, testable requirements
* Excellent communication skills  ability to explain credit concepts to a non\-credit (technical) audience
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, or related field; MBA/CA/CFA preferred but not mandatory



  





**Good to have** 




  




* Prior experience working in a fintech, NBFC, or bank's digital lending/product team
* Exposure to credit scoring models, rule engines, or decisioning platforms
* Basic understanding of SQL or data analysis tools (for validating logic/data, not development)



  





**What Quadcentrix has to offer** 




  





 We are in a rapidly evolving space so your role will not be immutable over time. You should expect that your role at Quadcentrix will evolve as the company grows in the years to come. This will provide you the opportunity to grow and to have a direct impact on shaping the nature of your contribution to the company. We do not fit in a box as there is no box today and we don't expect you to either.
 


* We trust you to execute your project deliverables and don't believe in micromanagement.
* We care about you and so we are going to be focused on making things better for you!
* We also believe in your potential, so we'll always focus on your learning, training, and development if it fits your goals!

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense\-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.


**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**
* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self\-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start\-Up Philosophy.’


**Required Experience**
* 10\-15 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
* Advanced degree in relevant subjects such as economics, public policy, or similar areas with strong training in evaluation, monitoring and learning.
* Experience in developing best\-in\-class monitoring, evaluation and learning approaches including designing and establishing these systems from scratch. Ideal experience gained in a complex organizational environment.
* Substantial experience of monitoring, evaluation and learning in the context of climate and energy programs, and/or programs driving systems change. Experience with contribution analysis will be a plus.
* Experience measuring the impact of grid infrastructure, utility performance or battery energy storage programs, including modelling expected impacts and validating them against realized results.
* Experience working in India and Southeast Asia, with familiarity with the region’s energy sector, utilities and government programs.
* Experience working independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants to ensure value for money and quality actionable outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong writing skills.
* Expertise in STATA, R or similar software packages, and MS Excel.
* Experience with Power BI or other dashboard tools, data engineering and applied use of AI tools for analysis will be a plus.


 Please submit your application on or before
 **2 October COB.** 
 The Global Energy Alliance reserves the right to close the job advert early if we receive a high number of suitable applications.
   

  

*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.*

To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.*

title: Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $1,600,000/year USD
description:
Most finance executives inherit a system. You will redesign one, then decide where the capital goes.
   

  

 Trilogy is looking for the executive who can turn a portfolio of businesses into a capital allocation system: continuously ranking where the next dollar should go, backing those decisions with rigorous models, and moving capital toward its highest\-return uses. You will own the calls that matter: fund or kill a business line; invest or hold; acquire or walk away; refinance or pay down debt. Every recommendation must connect strategy to cash, liquidity, covenants, risk, and enterprise value.
   

  

 Just as important, you will architect an AI\-native finance function built to scale without decision bottlenecks. This does not mean sprinkling AI tools onto a traditional finance organization. You will redesign reporting, planning, controls, portfolio monitoring, and decision support around what AI and automation can now do. You won't need to personally build every workflow, but you must use AI deeply enough to know its edges: where it accelerates analysis, where it fails, and where expert judgment must take over. The result should be a smaller, more senior, higher\-leverage finance organization rather than a growing pyramid of people and processes.
   

  

 You will operate directly with Trilogy's CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners, with personal accountability for the financial truth behind major decisions. As Deputy CFO, this is a $1\.6M/year W\-2 salaried role for someone who has already earned credibility at serious financial scale and now wants the mandate to compound enterprise value across an entire portfolio. If you want your impact measured by the quality of your capital decisions and the financial system you leave behind, apply.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Allocating capital across the portfolio: Run capital and portfolio reviews, rank competing uses of capital on risk\-adjusted return, and make clear fund, hold, restructure, exit, debt\-paydown, or acquisition recommendations.
* Architecting an AI\-native finance system: Redesign planning, reporting, consolidation, controls, portfolio monitoring, and financial workflows around AI, automation, and scalable systems rather than additional headcount.
* Driving investments and transactions: Build and defend the financial case for strategic investments, M\&A, financing, and refinancing, including integrated models, downside scenarios, capital structure, covenant implications, and execution plans.
* Owning board and capital\-partner communication: Give the CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners fast, quantified, defensible truth, with recommendations that make the decision and trade\-offs explicit.
* Building a high\-leverage finance leadership team: Set the bar for a small group of exceptional finance leaders while creating systems that allow new ventures and greater complexity to be absorbed without linear organizational growth.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Running finance as a reporting factory. Closing the books and producing audit workpapers are the Controller's responsibilities. Your job is to turn financial information into better capital decisions.
* Building a large finance organization to handle complexity. Scale should come from better systems, AI leverage, automation, and exceptional people, not layers of management.
* Adding AI as a superficial productivity tool. You will architect workflows around its real capabilities and limitations, which requires substantial firsthand use.
* Producing strategy decks without financial consequences. Major recommendations must carry the integrated model, downside case, capital implications, and execution guardrails behind them.
* Managing the board through narrative. The numbers, assumptions, risks, and recommended action should be clear enough to withstand scrutiny.


**Deputy Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities**
 Build a durable, AI\-native finance function that compounds enterprise value across Trilogy's portfolio by allocating capital to its highest\-return uses and creating financial systems and controls that scale without decision bottlenecks.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Experience as the most senior finance decision\-maker, or their direct deputy, for a business or portfolio with $100M\+ in annual revenue across multiple legal entities.
* Personal ownership of major capital\-allocation decisions, including the ability to explain what was funded, reduced, or rejected; the dollars involved; the trade\-offs; and your recommendation.
* Decision ownership on at least one $25M\+ closed M\&A, financing, or refinancing transaction, with direct responsibility for negotiation, financing selection, board recommendation, or post\-close integration.
* Direct experience presenting to and taking live questions from a board of directors.
* Ownership of an external audit relationship under US GAAP or IFRS, directly or through a Controller reporting to you.
* Hands\-on experience with a true enterprise ERP such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent.
* Recent experience re\-architecting a finance workflow around AI, with enough regular personal AI use to understand where the technology is reliable, where it is not, and how those boundaries should shape finance\-system design.
* Ability to operate integrated 3\-statement models and defend assumptions, downside scenarios, covenant math, capital structure, and recommendations under live questioning.
* Strong written and verbal English, with experience communicating directly with CEOs, boards, lenders, or capital partners.
* Located within the UTC−8 to UTC\+3 time\-zone range.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, MBA, or comparable finance credential.
* Earlier career experience in private equity, investment banking, M\&A, corporate finance, or another environment requiring rigorous modeling and high\-stakes capital decisions.
* Experience rebuilding a finance function rather than simply inheriting and operating one.
* Experience across a portfolio, multi\-entity, or PE\-backed operating environment.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $800 USD/hour, which equates to $1,600,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

title: Head - Finance & Accounting Quality
description:
**Head Finance and Accounting (F\&A) Quality** 




**Location: India (Open)** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 Lead the design, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of an independent Finance \& Accounting Quality function across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Record to\-Report (RTR), FP\&A, Master Data, and other F\&A towers.
 



 The role is responsible for establishing a centralized quality operating model that drives transaction accuracy, control compliance, defect prevention, customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and delivery risk reduction across all F\&A engagements.
 



 This leader will build and institutionalize a scalable quality governance framework covering quality methodology, sampling strategy, control validation, calibration, RCA, training, certification, reporting, and continuous improvement.
 



 The role will also own governance of process\-related training across F\&A, ensuring that teams are trained, assessed, and certified on approved processes, SOPs, desktop procedures, job aids, controls, and client\-specific requirements before performing activities independently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Quality Function Establishment \& Governance
 


* Design and institutionalize an enterprise\-wide F\&A Quality Management Framework.
* Establish independent QC operations across all F\&A towers.
* Define quality governance structure, operating cadence, escalation mechanisms, and review forums.
* Standardize defect taxonomy, scoring methodology, quality criteria, and control requirements.
* Create quality policies, SOPs, and governance standards.



**2\. Deployment of Dedicated QC Organization** 



* Build and scale centralized and account\-level QC teams.
* Define QC staffing models, spans, and coverage ratios.
* Drive deployment of QC Leads, Analysts, Calibration Specialists, and Quality Managers.
* Establish quality operating rhythms across all accounts.
* Ensure independence of quality teams from transaction processing teams.



**3\. Quality Control Framework** 



* Define risk\-based sampling methodology across PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, and Master Data.
* Establish process\-specific quality checklists and evaluation parameters.
* Implement layered quality reviews, control validation, and QA audit mechanisms.
* Drive quality coverage enhancement for high\-risk and judgment\-intensive activities.



**4\. RCA and Defect Prevention** 



* Establish structured defect prevention programs.
* Lead root cause analysis governance for all critical quality failures.
* Drive corrective and preventive action programs.
* Create enterprise defect repositories and knowledge\-sharing mechanisms.
* Ensure closure tracking and effectiveness validation of improvement actions.



**5\. Process Training Governance, Calibration \& Capability Assurance** 



* Establish periodic calibration programs across all F\&A towers.
* Drive certification and accreditation programs for Operations and QC teams.
* Create quality knowledge repositories and training curriculum.
* Lead bottom\-quartile improvement initiatives.
* Institutionalize process\-specific competency assessments.
* Own governance of process training across PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, Master Data, and other F\&A processes.
* Ensure all employees complete role\-based training on approved SOPs, desktop procedures, job aids, controls, policies, and client\-specific requirements.
* Implement training\-needs analysis linked to quality defects, process changes, audit findings, customer feedback, and control failures.
* Establish training calendars, trainer qualification standards, attendance and completion tracking, knowledge assessments, certification criteria, and refresher\-training triggers.
* Ensure new hires and employees moving to new activities are certified before independent processing or system access, in line with applicable operational requirements.
* Govern SOP and training\-content currency through version control, periodic reviews, approval workflows, and timely updates following process or policy changes.
* Monitor training effectiveness through post\-training quality performance, assessment results, error recurrence, control adherence, and action closure.
* Provide leadership visibility through training\-compliance dashboards, overdue actions, certification status, capability risks, and improvement plans.



**6\. Metrics, Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Build enterprise quality dashboards and scorecards.
* Track accuracy, defect density, customer defects, audit findings, control failures, RCA closure, sampling coverage, and training effectiveness.
* Present quality performance reviews to leadership and clients.
* Drive predictive quality analytics and trend identification.



**7\. Client Governance** 



* Act as quality SME during client reviews and governance meetings.
* Lead customer defect management and remediation programs.
* Provide executive updates on quality health, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Support quality commitments during transitions and new deal mobilization.



**8\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Partner with Transformation, Operational Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and Automation teams.
* Identify systemic quality improvement opportunities.
* Drive process standardization across accounts.
* Improve first\-time\-right performance and reduce recurring errors.
* Build a prevention\-focused quality culture.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Educational Qualification** 



* CA / CMA / CPA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt mandatory.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt preferred.



**Experience** 



* 15\-20 years of overall F\&A/BPS operations experience.
* Minimum 8\-10 years in Quality, Audit, Controls, Compliance, Operational Excellence, or Governance roles.
* Proven experience setting up dedicated Quality/QA/QC functions for large\-scale F\&A operations.
* Experience managing multi\-tower F\&A environments covering PTP, OTC, RTR, FP\&A, Master Data, and preferably Treasury / Tax.



**Mandatory Experience** 



* Creating centralized QA/QC organizations.
* Designing sampling and quality frameworks.
* Quality scorecard design and deployment.
* Internal audit and control adherence.
* Defect management and RCA governance.
* Client governance and executive reporting.
* Quality Control Team setup and capability development.
* Governance of process training, SOP readiness, knowledge assessment, certification, and training\-effectiveness measurement.
* Experience establishing learning governance for new hires, cross\-training, process changes, refresher training, and remedial training linked to quality outcomes.

description:
**Job Description – Manager Finance \& Accounts** 




**Designation:** 
 Manager – Finance \& Accounts
 



**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head\-F \& A

 Hospital\- Delhi (Shalimar Bagh)
 



 Maharishi Ayurveda hospital

 4\-5 years.

 B.Com /M.Com
 



  





  





**1\. Job Purpose** 




 To manage and control the day\-to\-day Finance \& Accounts operations of the hospital, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial reporting, effective cash\-flow management, statutory compliance, billing controls, bank reconciliation, internal controls, and adherence to financial policies and IFC requirements.
 



**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Hospital Billing \& Revenue Control** 



* Monitor daily
 **IPD, OPD, Pharmacy, Diagnostics, OT, Consultation and other hospital billing** 
 .
* Ensure billing is complete, accurate and properly supported by relevant documents.
* Review cancellations, discounts, refunds, credit notes and adjustments.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and coordinate with concerned departments for timely recovery.
* Ensure proper reconciliation between hospital billing software, collection records and bank receipts.
* Identify revenue leakage and implement appropriate controls.



**B. Daily Finance \& Accounting Operations** 



* Supervise day\-to\-day accounting activities and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and timely.
* Review
 **receipts, payments, journals, purchase entries and other accounting vouchers** 
 .
* Ensure all vouchers are properly supported and approved as per the organization's delegation of authority/IFC.
* Monitor cash and bank transactions.
* Maintain proper accounting records and documentation.



**C. Bank Reconciliation \& Cash Management** 



* Ensure
 **daily bank reconciliation** 
 of all hospital bank accounts.
* Reconcile hospital billing/collection data with bank statements.
* Investigate and resolve unreconciled transactions and differences on a timely basis.
* Monitor daily cash position and coordinate fund requirements.
* Ensure proper control over cash collections and deposits.



**D. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management** 



* Review vendor invoices, purchase bills and supporting documents.
* Ensure proper verification and approval before processing payments.
* Monitor vendor outstanding balances and ageing.
* Coordinate with Purchase/Stores/Administration for discrepancies in vendor invoices.
* Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments as per approved terms.



**E. Accounts Receivable** 



* Monitor patient, corporate, TPA and other receivables.
* Prepare and review ageing reports.
* Follow up with concerned departments for collection of outstanding amounts.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of patient/TPA/corporate accounts.
* Highlight long\-pending and disputed balances to management.



**F. MIS \& Management Reporting** 



* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly financial MIS as required by management.
* Prepare revenue, collection, expenditure and profitability reports.
* Provide management with analysis of:
* IPD/OPD revenue
* Collection
* Receivables
* Expenses
* Cash flow
* Department\-wise performance
* Budget vs. actual
* Highlight significant variances and provide explanations/action points.



**I. Internal Control \& IFC** 



* Ensure compliance with the organization's
 **Internal Financial Controls (IFC)** 
 .
* Review financial processes and identify control gaps.
* Ensure segregation of duties and appropriate authorization levels.
* Conduct periodic checks of billing, receipts, payments, bank reconciliation and accounting records.
* Report irregularities, control weaknesses and suspected financial leakage to management.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions.



**J. Audit** 



* Coordinate with internal, statutory and external auditors.
* Provide required schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents.
* Ensure audit observations are addressed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain proper audit trails and documentation.
* Follow up on pending audit observations.



**K. Inventory \& Pharmacy Finance Controls** 



* Coordinate with Stores/Pharmacy for financial controls over inventory.
* Review stock\-related accounting and reconciliation.
* Monitor stock adjustments, shortages, expiry and write\-offs.
* Ensure appropriate authorization for inventory adjustments.
* Train staff on accounting procedures, hospital billing controls and financial policies.
* Ensure timely completion of month\-end and year\-end closing activities.



**4\. Month\-End Responsibilities** 



* Complete monthly books of accounts within the defined timeline.
* Ensure all income and expenses are properly accounted for.
* Complete bank, vendor, patient, TPA and other reconciliations.
* Review provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and outstanding liabilities.
* Prepare monthly MIS and financial analysis along with preparation of Financials.
* Coordinate with auditors and management for month\-end review.
* Ensure zero/acceptable unexplained reconciliation differences.

**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

 Real Jobs Consulting Services is a trusted placement consultancy based in Gurugram, specializing in a wide range of recruitment and HR solutions. The firm offers HR consultancy, placement and manpower recruitment services, domestic placement support, career consultancy, and work\-from\-home opportunities to a diverse client base. With deep knowledge of placement operations and strong local market presence, Real Jobs Consulting Services has built long\-standing relationships with companies and professionals across Gurugram. Applicants can expect to work with a firm that values professionalism, collaboration, and client success.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Real Estate Finance Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for analyzing real estate investments, evaluating project viability, and preparing financial models and reports to support commercial and residential property decisions. The specialist will review market data and real estate economics, assess risks, and collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to structure financing solutions. Daily tasks include coordinating with clients and lenders, supporting sales teams with financial insights, and ensuring compliance with relevant financial and real estate regulations. The role also involves preparing presentations, maintaining accurate documentation, and contributing to strategic recommendations that align with clients’ business objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Finance, including financial analysis, modeling, budgeting, and risk assessment.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Commercial Real Estate and Real Estate, including property types, valuation concepts, and transaction processes.
* Candidates should possess understanding of Real Estate Economics, including market trends, demand and supply dynamics, and investment drivers.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-related skills, including client relationship management, consultative selling, and negotiation.

* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial software tools, with strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex financial information clearly.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




  





 Build the 3–5 year plan connected to strategic priorities (product/ mix roadmap, capacity, margin levers).
 



 Design and run the annual budgeting cycle (opex \+ capex) and institute rolling forecasts (monthly/quarterly as agreed).
 



 Formalize forecast ownership across functions with a governance calendar, review cadence, and escalation process
 



 Build and maintain a driver\-based model (volume/price/mix, yield/scrap, energy, conversion costs, working capital, capacity utilization).
 



 Deliver scenario/ sensitivity analysis for decisions and IPO/ investor “what\-if” questions.
 



 Build a scalable planning and reporting architecture around SAP S/4HANA ERP, with clear master\-data alignment and model governance.
 



 Establish KPI dictionary (definitions, owners, refresh cadence, reconciliations).
 



 Build a “copper rolling industry intelligence pack”: market/price drivers, peer cost/margin references, demand and product trends, and conversion economics.
 



 Build a cross\-functional “knowledge bank” (process notes, driver definitions, assumptions book, KPI dictionary, model documentation) aligned to recognized KM principles.
 



  





**Skill\-set** 









 8\+ years in FP\&A/strategic finance in a manufacturing environment with strong cost and operational driver orientation (metals preferred).
 



 Demonstrated ownership of AOP/budget, rolling forecast, and long\-range plan cycles—not as a contributor, but as the person accountable for outcomes.
 



 Strong systems capability: led (or co\-led) ERP\-integrated planning/reporting implementations or large driver\-based models anchored to ERP data; comfortable operating in S/4HANA\-centric data environments.
 



 Ability to build from scratch: governance, templates, definitions, documentation, and team.

title: Specialist - Investments
