Your primary responsibilities will involve assisting with a range of institutional investing activities across different geographies, including collecting and analyzing data, researching investment strategies, portfolio construction and performance analytics reports.
   

  

 In your role, you will be the content specialist/trainer and peer reviewer of crucial tasks including but not limited to quarterly performance evaluation reports including Defined Contribution, Defined Benefit and Not for Profit clients, investment policy statements, and manager commentaries among other tasks. You will be expected to drive/lead ad hoc projects aimed at creating positive business impact/value\-add for the business.

**We will count on you for:**

* Preparing and reviewing quarterly manager commentary by assessing the performance of fund/investment strategies and linking the performance with market/economic developments and the investment process of the asset managers.
* Lead and support client projects or ad\-hoc projects beyond reporting

* Review and amend investment policy statements
* Fund managers screening and preparation of search report
* Project management, peer review, process training and development of team members

* Conduct research and write research papers on macro/micro economic environment and Investment industry
* Lead and participate in knowledge development initiatives

* Play key role in strategic and operations improvement initiatives
* Support Process Leads in preparation of periodic KPIs and dashboard reporting
* Coach and guide the junior team members and new team members


**What you need to have:**
* 3\+ years’ experience in the wealth management/investment industry overall
* Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree in finance or economics with demonstrated academic achievement
* Progress towards professional certification such as CFA, CAIA, CIPM
* Proficient understanding in Wealth Management, Investment Management industry and asset classes (equity, fixed income and alternatives)
* Strong logical and analytical skills with attention to details
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office, third party tools – Bloomberg, Morning Star, Lipper, etc
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, business communication, and time management skills
* Demonstrated success working with out\-of\-country professionals
* Ability to multitask, manage multiple priorities and work in a rapidly changing and dynamic environment, ensuring standards and deadlines are met and keeping others informed and up\-to\-date
* Stakeholder management; managing escalations and ensuring excellent service delivery


**What makes you stand out?**
* Ability to understand the link between data, client needs and its application to the “bigger picture”
* Excellent client management skills
* Positive attitude \& ability to adapt ever\-changing environment
* Strong multi\-tasking skills
* Domain expertise relevant to wealth management/investment advisory/consulting
* Willing to learn and a strong team player with a collaborative approach
* Effective team management skills
* Good analytical skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

title: Assistant Vice President - Stress Testing
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Assistant Vice President – Stress Testing.**
**Purpose Of The Role**
 This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and well\-governed stress testing results and management information end\-to\-end, including running/consolidating balance sheet and P\&L outputs, coordinating stakeholder submissions and regulatory responses, maintaining data and systems and strengthening the control environment through robust documentation, evidence, issue/risk management, and continuous process automation/improvement.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Support end\-to\-end production of management information and consolidated stress\-testing results. Execute and/or support model runs and results production for balance sheet and P\&L components including loans, deposits, revenue etc. and produce consolidated results.
* Submitting overlays, journals into TM1, CART etc. and ensure the MI is accurate, robust and aligned with the latest management hierarchies. Collaborate with Group to ensure any PRA submissions are completed timely, liaise on Bank of England queries, prepare draft responses relating to unstructured data requests.
* Perform analysis of stress test outputs including movement/variance analysis, sensitivities, trend reviews, and identification of key drivers. Managing stakeholders to ensure timely and complete submissions. Tracking actions, recording key decision points, distributing meeting materials and minutes.
* Support T\-zero data preparation for entity returns, coordinate with Group and ensure data quality throughout the process. Support R\&C and coordination of various stress test exercises and related approvals/governance, including coordination of inputs and evidence packs for exercises such as GIST/GRP/RST and relevant UK/Group regulatory requests (e.g., PRA\-related).
* Partner with model owners and accountable executives in Business, Risk, Finance to analyse, review and challenge stress test submissions. Support the impact assessment and change implementation for various stress\-testing data and systems, including CART, TM1 and maintain key mappings for products, global businesses, MICA etc.
* Implement new models, tools, processes or automated solutions to support any changes in the process or requirements. Build accurate, validated datasets for each stress\-testing cycle, with no critical data\-quality issues, and develop and maintain validation tools to support review activities.
* Improve efficiency, convert manual spreadsheets to automated solutions by leveraging HSBC artificial intelligence tools and other methods of automation. Ensuring processes are run in accordance with the Control framework and agreed procedures.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality stress testing documentation (methodology narratives, process/run books, evidence packs, control checklists, assumptions logs, and decision logs). Providing accurate information status reporting, risk and update on issues.
* Develop and actively manage delivery plans covering key milestones and interdependencies and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure timely delivery. Support the development and maintenance of process flows, controls, documentation etc., embedding HSBC principles and ensure compliance with risk management framework.
* Support the annual Risk Control Assessment and contribute to ongoing strengthening of the stress testing control environment. Execute and evidence process controls and assurance activities, including maintaining records in relevant tooling (e.g., Helios for controls/assurance, where applicable).


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Qualifications: ACA, ACCA, MBA or similar.
* Experience: Demonstrable experience coordinating internal and external stress test submissions, with a strong understanding of governance and regulatory expectations. Strong analytical skills with business analysis experience or equivalent.
* Data and Systems: Strong understanding of data architecture, finance and accounting systems – ability to work with large, complex datasets.
* Presentation and Communication: Ability to present results effectively to senior stakeholders and distill complex messages into understandable plain English for non\-technical colleagues. Have confidence to review, challenge and improve submissions while maintaining strong relationships.
* Produce high\-quality outputs: Proven ability to produce high\-quality outputs, and to write concise, technically accurate papers, with strong attention to detail and clear audit trail.
* Delivery discipline and control mindset: Strong planning, tracking and reporting capability (run books, RAID, milestones). Understand risk management and control frameworks.
* Problem\-solving: Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritise effectively and keep delivery moving at pace.
* Tools: Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); MI systems (TM1, CART, Saracen), and knowledge of Workviva, Harmony, RRIS.


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
**www.hsbc.com/careers**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Senior Analyst, AFR
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
   

  

 The role is within the AXA XL Reinsurance Portfolio Analytics team. Portfolio Analytics operates as part of a global reinsurance network, working with underwriters, actuaries and business heads across multiple regions, with a culture of collaboration and participation across a range of high\-profile projects. The team seeks to make full use of available data sources to better manage reinsurance portfolios and enhance the reinsurance operation’s profitability. The team conceptualizes, designs and develops innovative management information for underwriters, actuaries and senior management. The team’s other objectives include creating high\-end analytical solutions and automating manual processes using the latest technologies.
   

  

**What You’ll Be DOING**
 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

* Create and run standard reports whilst looking to automate their generation and distribution. Review management information created by other people across the Reinsurance segment.
* Create new innovative management information using Excel, Qlik Sense, VBA and / or PowerBI.
* Support product management within the reinsurance operations. Work with people from across the reinsurance segment to determine how to best measure risk and profitability for various lines of business and how to construct and manage portfolios accordingly.
* Responsibility for checking that the reinsurance data is correct. Setting up a process for regular data checks, investigating any potential issues and taking any appropriate actions.
* Take ownership of mappings, making sure any new mapping required is added in a timely manner.
* Understand/explain data and assist the reinsurance community with any questions including how to access required data, definitions and the source of data.
* To assist with complex data needs, sourcing the appropriate data from multiple reinsurance systems.
* Test any new developments to the Reinsurance Analytics project before they are released.
* To be involved in deciding the direction of any specifying new development to the Reinsurance Analytics project.
* Provide training and support on the Reinsurance Analytics tools for a broad user base across multiple regions and functions – including underwriting, actuarial and senior management.


 You will report to the Senior Lead, Pricing Data \& Reporting.
   

  

**What You Will BRING**
 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
* University Graduate with qualification B.E/B.Tech(CS/IT).
* Excellent analytical, research and problem\-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of SQL.
* Desirable skill but not mandatory Knowledge of Python programming language.


**Desired Skills And Abilities**
* Outstanding computer application skills, specifically Excel and experience using any of the following BI applications is desirable e.g. Qlik Sense, Qlik View, PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.
* Ability to multi\-task and work effectively in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Exposure to Data Analytics / Machine Learning preferred.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.


**Who WE Are**
 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.

Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk \& Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.

These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs, and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.
 



  





 Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co\-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry\-grounded viewpoints.
 



  





  





 Position Title
 



**Consultant / Senior Consultant – Credit Risk Model Development \& Validation**

 **2–7 Years** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking talented professionals with expertise in
 **Credit Risk Model Development and Validation**

**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Model Development

 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 Domain Expertise
 


* Experience in:
* Credit Risk Model Development
* Credit Risk Model Validation

* IFRS 9 Modeling \& Validation
* Basel/IRB Frameworks
* Stress Testing

 Technical Skills

* Python
* SAS
* R
* SQL

* Logistic Regression
* Linear Regression
* Time Series Analysis
* Survival Analysis
* Machine Learning Techniques
* Experience handling large\-scale banking and financial datasets.



  





 Regulatory Knowledge
 


* Strong understanding of:
* RBI Regulations
* Basel II / Basel III
* IFRS 9
* IRB Approaches
* Model Governance Frameworks



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, or related disciplines.
* FRM, CFA, PRM, or relevant quantitative certifications are preferred.
* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, consulting firms, or financial institutions.



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to translate complex quantitative concepts into business insights.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced consulting environment.

With a total capacity of more than 13\.4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150\+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1\.9 % of India’s power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0\.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1\.1% India’s total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1\.3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India’s policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew’s current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.

title: Veg Oil Trader
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.
   

  

 This position is in our Ag \& Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions.
   

  

 Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

 The Vege Oil Trader will be responsible for Merchandising Imported Edible Oil such as CPO, RBD Oln and SFO into the local Indian market from various port location but mainly pertaining to the East coast of India (KP/Kaki/Chennai/Haldia). In this role, you will monitor a supplier base and fulfill transactions, delivering commodities that meet production requirements and specifications in terms of timing, volume, quantity and cost.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**Trading \& Commercial Strategy**
* Develop and execute profitable trading strategies for imported edible oils across Indian markets.
* Manage physical trading positions, inventory exposure, and pricing risk to optimize portfolio profitability.
* Identify and capture arbitrage opportunities between origins, ports, customer segments, and competing oils.
* Monitor global vegetable oil markets, including Palm Oil, Soybean Oil, Sunflower Oil, and related feedstocks, and translate market intelligence into actionable trading decisions.
* Build and maintain trading books to achieve volume, margin, and P\&L targets.


**Market Analysis \& Price Risk Management**
* Analyze domestic and international market fundamentals including supply\-demand balances, crop outlooks, import parity, crush economics, stock levels, and government policies.
* Monitor futures markets, basis relationships, currency movements, freight rates, and competitor activity to support trading decisions.
* Recommend pricing, hedging, and risk\-management strategies to manage market volatility and protect margins.
* Work closely with Risk Management and Trade Analytics teams to manage position exposure and portfolio performance.


**Customer \& Supplier Development**
* Build strategic relationships with refiners, food manufacturers, distributors, and trade houses across India.
* Identify new customer opportunities and develop trading solutions tailored to customer requirements.
* Negotiate commercial contracts involving pricing, volume, delivery terms, and payment structures.
* Collaborate with international trading desks and suppliers to optimize sourcing and trade flows.


**Portfolio Optimization \& Execution**
* Manage inventory and sales liquidation across bonded, high\-seas, and ex\-tank positions to maximize returns.
* Optimize freight, storage, and logistics economics to enhance trade margins.
* Ensure effective coordination with logistics, execution, finance, quality, credit, and operations teams to support seamless trade execution.
* Evaluate inventory holding strategies and working capital impacts to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.


**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration**
* Partner closely with TDA and Market Intelligence teams to assess:
+ Domestic crushing margins and crush economics.
+ Import parity and export competitiveness.
+ Port stock positions and inventory trends.
+ Regional demand patterns and substitution dynamics between edible oils.

* Provide market insights and trade recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Contribute to regional and global market outlook discussions and commercial strategy development.


**Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of vegetable oil fundamentals, futures markets, risk management, and physical commodity trading.
* Proven ability to interpret market data and convert insights into profitable trading decisions.
* Experience managing physical positions, customer portfolios, and price\-risk exposure.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and relationship management capabilities.
* Ability to make decisions in fast\-moving and volatile commodity markets.
* P\&L\-driven mindset with a strong focus on value creation and margin optimization.

title: Financial Consulting Supervisor- Accounting and Finance Optimization
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The RSM US Offices in India (USI) supports RSM U.S. risk consulting, transaction advisory, technical accounting, financial consulting, technology and management consulting, tax and assurance engagement teams by providing access to highly skilled professionals for repeatable business processes over an extended business day.
   

  

 RSM is looking for a manager to join our Accounting and Finance Consulting (AFC) team. Changing economies, new accounting policies and evolving tax regulations mean that business and professional services firms face an ever\-changing business landscape. With more than 80 years of industry expertise, RSM has helped thousands of firms to achieve their business objectives. Our clients include firms in a variety of industries, including financial services, technology, and commercial to name just a few. Experienced in serving clients with international presence, and a number of diverse organizational structures, our professionals can help develop meaningful solutions for your business.
   

  

 The Manager will be an integral team member by assisting in our AFC practice/e. They will work with teams of technical accounting on different engagements in area of Business Combination Accounting, New Accounting Standard Implementation, Capital Market Readiness and Audit readiness. This team assists clients to better understand the implication of changes in accounting standards guidelines as well to assist them in area of complex accounting matters. Our clients include firms in a variety of industries, including financial services, technology, life sciences, and manufacturing to name just a few.
   

  

**Qualification And Minimum Entry Requirements**
* Chartered Accountant/CPA with minimum of 4\-6 years of technical accounting experience.
* Understanding of audit services with mediocre to in\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS

* Experience in leading projects for mergers and acquisitions accounting (business combinations).

* Advanced written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in drafting sections of Form F1, F4, 10\-K, 10\-Q, S\-1, S4
* PCAOB financial statement uplift and Audit Readiness assistance.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and client management skills

* Open to stretching on working hours in periods of peak capital markets and merger \& acquisition activity.

**Key Skills To Accelerate Career**

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Panasonic is a diversified technology company offering integrated solutions for consumers, businesses, and communities. In India, the company provides a wide range of consumer electronics and appliances, including televisions, cameras, home appliances, and beauty products, along with B2B solutions in energy storage, smart factory systems, security and surveillance, automotive, and industrial devices. Panasonic India operates as Panasonic Life Solutions India as of August 1, 2022\.

 This is a full\-time, on\-site Financial Planning Analyst role based in Gurugram. The role involves building and maintaining financial models, supporting decision\-making for investments and initiatives, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams such as operations, sales, and corporate finance. * Candidates should possess strong Financial Planning and Finance skills, with the ability to support strategic and operational decision\-making.

* Candidates should possess capabilities in Budgeting \& Forecasting, ensuring accurate, timely, and realistic financial projections.
* Candidates should possess experience in Financial Modeling, including building and maintaining models for scenario analysis and business planning.
* **Relevant qualification such as CA is mandatory.**
* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial planning tools, familiarity with ERP systems, and strong attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross\-functional teams and present financial insights to stakeholders.
* Prior experience in financial analysis or planning, preferably within technology, manufacturing, or diversified business environments, is beneficial.

title: Cost Manager
description:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  





 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  





 Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  





 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Role Overview
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cost Manager** 
 to lead cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control activities across projects and business operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project cost management, commercial controls, financial analysis, and stakeholder management, with proven experience in delivering projects within budget while maximizing value and minimizing risks.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Cost Planning \& Budget Management
   

  




* Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, and financial forecasts.
* Establish cost control procedures, standards, and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses and recommend cost optimization strategies.



 Cost Control \& Reporting
   

  




* Track actual costs against budget and forecast variances.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, and performance metrics for senior management.
* Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities impacting project costs.
* Ensure timely identification and escalation of cost overruns and mitigation measures.



 Contract \& Commercial Management
   

  




* Review contracts, change orders, claims, and commercial implications.
* Evaluate contractor invoices, variations, and payment applications.
* Support procurement and vendor negotiations from a cost management perspective.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and financial obligations.



 Forecasting \& Risk Management
   

  




* Lead monthly forecasting and cash flow projections.
* Identify financial risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support project teams in scenario analysis and decision\-making processes.
* Maintain contingency planning and risk adjustment mechanisms.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Partner with project managers, finance teams, procurement teams, and external stakeholders.
* Present cost performance updates to leadership and clients.
* Provide commercial guidance throughout project lifecycle phases.



 Process Improvement
   

  




* Drive continuous improvements in cost management methodologies and systems.
* Implement best practices, automation tools, and reporting efficiencies.
* Mentor and guide junior cost engineers/analysts.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 10–15 years of experience in Cost Management, Project Controls, Commercial Management, or related functions.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial reporting.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale projects and complex budgets.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and project management tools.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant* 
***post MBA***
*experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands\-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high\-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem\-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Senior Associate will own high\-impact workstreams for Energy\-sector clients, combining deep sub\-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O\&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub\-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client\-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time\-sensitive engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
* Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem\-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value\-creation opportunities.
* Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
* Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
* Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy\-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
* Adapt across adjacent Energy sub\-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub\-sector, such as O\&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
* Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
* Advanced problem\-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
* Exposure to multiple Energy sub\-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
* Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
* A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
* Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub\-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O\&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
* A record of owning analytical and problem\-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
* The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
* A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast\-paced, high\-expectation environments.
* Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands\-on delivery.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on consequential Energy\-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
* Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub\-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
* Join a performance\-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
* Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy\-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.



  





**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to work on high\-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
* A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross\-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
* A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

title: Senior Manager, Finance
description:
**Role Summary**
 IORA Ecological Solutions is seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant with a minimum of 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience to lead and strengthen the organisation’s finance and accounting function. The Senior Manager, Finance will provide leadership across financial management, accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, budgeting, financial reporting, project finance, internal controls, systems and financial planning. The role will work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and will be an important finance partner in supporting IORA’s organisational growth and project portfolio.
   

  

 The position combines strong technical finance and accounting responsibilities with systems strengthening, process improvement and an important external\-facing role. The Senior Manager, Finance will serve as the primary finance interface with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders, and will be expected to represent IORA with credibility and professionalism.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Accounting
* Lead end\-to\-end accounting operations and ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closure.
* Review financial statements, ledgers, bank reconciliations and statutory records to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking transactions, advances and other routine financial operations.
* Ensure effective cash management and timely availability of funds for organisational and project requirements.
* Provide financial oversight across IORA’s projects and programmes.
* Statutory Compliance, Taxation \& Audit
* Oversee TDS, GST, Income Tax and other applicable statutory compliances, filings and reconciliations.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, tax, donor and other audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable financial and tax regulations and advise management on their implications.
* Ensure robust financial documentation, audit trails and compliance with applicable requirements.
* Financial Planning, Budgeting \& MIS
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting and cash\-flow planning.
* Prepare and review monthly MIS, budget\-versus\-actual analysis, variance analysis and management reports.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decision\-making.
* Work with programme and project teams to prepare project budgets, monitor expenditure and manage financial performance.
* Support financial modelling and analysis for new projects, partnerships and funding opportunities.
* Internal Controls, Systems \& Process Improvement
* Strengthen IORA’s internal financial controls, SOPs, approval workflows and financial governance systems.
* Oversee accounting records in Tally/ERP and play a key role in the development and implementation of IORA’s new ERP and finance systems.
* Drive process improvements, automation and standardisation across finance operations.
* Ensure proper financial documentation and controls for procurement, payments, expenses, advances and project accounting.
* Identify financial risks and strengthen systems for risk mitigation and compliance.
* Project, Donor \& Grant Finance
* Provide financial oversight for externally funded projects, grants and partnerships, including budgeting, fund utilisation, financial reporting and compliance.
* Ensure compliance with donor\-specific financial requirements, contractual obligations and reporting timelines.
* Work closely with project teams and external partners to resolve financial issues and ensure effective financial management.
* Support preparation of financial components of project proposals, budgets, funding applications and partnership agreements.
* External Donor \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all finance\-related matters with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders.
* Lead financial discussions with donors and partners on budgets, fund utilisation, financial reporting, audits, forecasts, amendments and financial queries.
* Prepare and deliver clear, compelling and decision\-oriented financial presentations and reports for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Represent IORA in finance\-related discussions with donors, funders, auditors, financial institutions and partners.
* Support senior management in engagement with prospective funders and partners, including financial due diligence, financial modelling, proposals and negotiations.
* Serve as a strong external face of IORA on financial matters, building confidence in IORA’s financial systems, controls and stewardship of funds.
* Team Leadership \& Organisational Support
* Lead, mentor and develop the finance team and promote a culture of accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted finance partner to the CEO, senior management and project leads.
* Build financial management capacity across non\-finance teams.
* Work closely with internal teams and external consultants on finance\-related matters.


**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is essential.
* Minimum 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in finance and accounts, with experience in a role involving ownership of core finance functions.
* Strong experience in financial management, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, financial reporting, audit management and internal controls.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or mentoring finance teams and working directly with senior management.
* Experience in managing donor\-funded projects, grants or partnerships, particularly with international donors or development agencies, is highly desirable.
* Experience in a consulting firm, professional services organisation, research organisation, NGO/development organisation or sustainability\-focused organisation is preferred.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong working knowledge of accounting, TDS, GST, Income Tax, statutory compliance and audit requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in budgeting, financial forecasting, cash\-flow management, MIS, variance analysis and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable management insights.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, including the ability to develop clear, compelling financial presentations for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and advanced formulas; Power Query is a plus.
* Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems or other accounting software, with an interest in process automation and digital finance systems.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


**What The Role Offers**
* A leadership role with direct exposure to the CEO and senior management and the opportunity to shape IORA’s finance function as the organisation grows.
* An opportunity to contribute beyond accounting and compliance, including financial planning, project and donor finance, financial analysis, systems strengthening and organisational decision\-making.
* Significant external exposure to international donors, funding agencies, development partners, auditors and other stakeholders.
* Exposure to diverse projects and partnerships spanning climate action, nature conservation, sustainable livelihoods, carbon markets and innovative finance.
* An opportunity to build robust, scalable finance systems and processes in a dynamic, mission\-driven organisation.


**Application Process**
 To apply, please submit your resume and a one\-page letter to careers@ioraecological.com stating your understanding of IORA, why you are interested in joining IORA, and where you see yourself after five years in collaboration with IORA.
   

  

 Subject Line: Application for Senior Manager, Finance
   

  

 To know more about IORA, please visit: https://ioraecological.com

 Junior Manager – Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Delhi

 Work from office

 Qualified CA

 1\-2 Years Post Qualification

 Anywhere in India

* General Accounting
* GST / TDS

 Qualified CA
   

  

**Job Description**
* Manage day\-to\-day accounting activities including booking of liabilities, expenses and payment entries in SAP.

* Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliation and ensure timely clearance of outstanding balances.
* Conduct bank GL scrutiny, bank reconciliations and obtain bank balance and loan confirmations for monthly closing.
* Handle inter\-company reconciliation and ensure timely resolution of accounting differences.
* Support monthly closing activities including expense provisioning, accruals, treasury runs, interest booking and loan creation.
* Prepare monthly estimates, balance sheet schedules and support timely finalization of monthly accounts.

* Support TDS, TCS, GST and other applicable statutory compliance activities.
* Prepare MIS reports, management reports, AOP vs Actual analysis and data for Board presentations and AOP reviews.
* Support statutory, internal, IFCR, stock, quarterly, tax and GST audits by providing workings, supporting documents, confirmations, loan statements, treasury reports and other audit requirements.

* Maintain proper EHS/finance\-related documentation, statutory records, audit trails and supporting schedules as required.


**Key Skills**
 SAP, General Accounting, Vendor Reconciliation, Bank Reconciliation, GST, TDS, TCS, Month\-End Closing, Treasury Operations, Loan Accounting, MIS Reporting, AOP vs Actuals, Statutory Audit, Internal Audit, Tax Audit, GST Audit, Balance Sheet Finalization, Inter\-company Reconciliation, Vendor Invoice Verification

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Investment Operations & Reconciliation
description:
**Department:** 
 Investment Operations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 years preferred
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 


 About Mentor Wealth
 
 Mentor Wealth is a financial services organisation focused on helping investors build long\-term financial well\-being through trusted, technology\-enabled and process\-driven solutions.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Investment Operations professional** 
 to lead transaction control, reconciliation, operational accuracy and risk controls across day\-to\-day investment operations.
 


 About the Role
 
 This is a critical financial\-control role responsible for ensuring that investor transactions are
 **executed accurately, accounted for correctly, reconciled completely and supported by proper documentation** 
 .
 



 The role will oversee transaction processing, reconciliation, exception management, team supervision and operational controls across mutual fund and related investment operations.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**Transaction \& Investment Operations** 



* Supervise purchase, redemption, switch, SIP, STP, SWP and other investment transactions.
* Ensure accurate order punching, payment verification and transaction processing.
* Verify investor instructions, amounts, folio details, scheme information and supporting documents.
* Monitor rejected, delayed, unmatched and partially processed transactions.



**Reconciliation \& Financial Controls** 



* Perform and supervise reconciliation of units, holdings, investor ledgers and transaction records.
* Manage
 **Bank, AMC/RTA, AUM and Commission/Brokerage reconciliations** 
 .
* Identify, investigate and resolve mismatches and discrepancies.
* Maintain daily transaction control and ensure all exceptions are appropriately tracked and closed.
* Coordinate with Accounts for payment, receipt, revenue and ledger reconciliation.



**Team \& Operational Controls** 



* Implement and monitor
 **maker\-checker controls** 
 for critical transactions.
* Allocate work, monitor team performance and independently verify critical activities.
* Maintain transaction records, audit trails and supporting documentation.
* Ensure operational processes meet applicable KYC, documentation, audit and compliance requirements.



**Exception \& Risk Management** 



* Maintain an exception and pending transaction register.
* Investigate root causes of operational discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
* Identify potential operational risks and escalate critical issues appropriately.
* Ensure investor\-facing records are supported by accurate and reconciled source data.



**Technology \& Process Improvement** 



* Strengthen operational controls through Excel, CRM and transaction\-management systems.
* Develop MIS, dashboards and exception reports.
* Identify opportunities for automation and reduction of manual processes.
* Contribute to SOP development and continuous improvement of investment operations.


 What We’re Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **highly analytical, detail\-oriented and comfortable working with numbers, systems and financial data** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have strong reconciliation and accounting\-control skills.
* Be meticulous about transaction accuracy and documentation.
* Be comfortable investigating discrepancies and identifying root causes.
* Have a structured approach to problem\-solving and exception management.
* Be capable of supervising a team while maintaining strong individual ownership.
* Be comfortable working in a deadline\-driven investment operations environment.
* Have a strong control mindset and attention to detail.


 Preferred Qualifications \& Experience
 * B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent Finance/Accounting background preferred.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience** 
 in mutual fund operations, wealth management, AMC/RTA operations, brokerage, banking or investment\-platform operations.
* Hands\-on experience with mutual fund transaction processing and reconciliation.
* Experience with
 **CAMS, KFintech, NSE NMF, BSE StAR MF, AMC portals or similar platforms** 
 will be an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in
 **Advanced Excel** 
 and reconciliation/MIS reporting.
* Experience with CRM, accounting or transaction\-management systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of relevant investment operations, compliance and documentation requirements.


 Key Areas of Ownership
 
 The selected candidate will be expected to contribute towards:
 


* Transaction Control \& Maker\-Checker Framework
* Daily Transaction Reconciliation
* Bank Reconciliation
* AMC/RTA Reconciliation
* AUM Reconciliation
* Commission/Brokerage Reconciliation
* Exception \& Pending Transaction Management
* Investor Asset \& Holding Reconciliation
* Operations MIS \& Dashboards
* Audit Trail \& Documentation
* SOPs and Process Controls
* Operational Risk Management
* Process Automation \& Continuous Improvement


 How to Apply
 
 Interested candidates can apply with an updated resume and a brief note covering:
 


1. Investment/mutual fund transaction platforms handled
2. Reconciliation responsibilities owned
3. A significant operational discrepancy or error identified and resolved
4. Advanced Excel/accounting/operations systems used
5. Team size currently or previously supervised



**Join Mentor Wealth and take ownership of building accurate, controlled and scalable investment operations.**

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

* Thrives under pressure, embraces change with an open mindset, and exhibits a strong commitment to continuous process improvement and personal growth

description:

The Private Credit team underwrites investment opportunities across public and private corporate credit, commercial real estate, loan portfolios, and special situations in Europe and North America. The Asset Management function sits within this team, monitoring investment performance and dealing cash flows, and managing key commercial aspects of the portfolio including exit strategies, servicer effectiveness, and pricing.

title: Senior Analyst - HEOR
description:
**Description**
**You’re driven, resourceful, and above all else \- remarkably smart.**
 In this role, you will support the HEOR team in evidence generation and deriving solutions for clients in the healthcare and life sciences sectors. You will contribute to conducting literature reviews and assist in the development of value communications such as SLR/TLR reports, manuscripts, dossiers, and presentations. You will:
   

  

* Perform database and literature searches to provide a situational review and analysis, in the form of comprehensive and structured reports, on the available evidence related to various health economics and outcomes aspects, such as clinical data, epidemiology, burden of disease, treatment patterns, unmet needs, etc.
* Assist/support in the intellectual planning and design of Systematic Literature Review (SLR) and Targeted Literature Review (TLR) projects at the proposal writing stage
* Undertake SLR/TLR projects from design to execution, including screening, data extraction, qualitative summary, and report writing
* Support the development of Global Value Dossiers (GVDs), Reimbursement Dossiers, and Manuscripts, ensuring high\-quality content that aligns with payer and publication standards
* Support in the development of impactful slide decks to effectively translate complex health economic evidence into clear, visually compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders
* Manage your own workload to ensure delivery according to agreed milestones and timelines
* Support project leads in day\-to\-day project activities, ensuring assigned tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Collaborate closely with project team members, contributing to discussions and sharing ideas.
* Provide guidance and quality oversight to Analysts and Junior Associates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-building initiatives, training, and process improvement activities.


**Essential Requirements:**
* Postgraduate degree (M.pharm or equivalent) or PhD with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in scientific discipline including HEOR, epidemiology, or market access
* Good oral/written communication skills along with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of office applications, e.g. MS Word/ PowerPoint/ Excel/EndNote


**Desired Requirements:**
* Hands\-on experience in Literature Review Reports, Value Dossiers and Manuscript writing


 At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.
   

  

**Why Syneos Health?** 
 Here, you’re a part of the big picture. You will collaborate with colleagues across clinical and commercial disciplines to guide premarket development through post\-market commercial strategy. Every project is a chance to solve a new challenge, learn from your colleagues, and advance your career. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.
   

  

 Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

description:
**About OnDemand International** 




 OnDemand International is a global corporate services and business mobility firm supporting businesses, entrepreneurs, and enterprises with international company formation, compliance coordination, accounting support, and business expansion services.
 



 Our finance function manages multi\-entity and multi\-currency operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other international markets. We are looking for a strong finance professional who can bring structure, accuracy, reporting discipline, financial control, and operational visibility to a growing global business.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are hiring a 
 **Senior Finance Manager – International Finance Operations \& Management** 




**Reporting** 
  to manage and strengthen our finance function across multiple countries. This role is best suited for candidates with a strong academic background in commerce, accounting, and finance, preferably with a 
 **B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance** 
  qualification, along with hands\-on experience in accounting operations, management reporting, financial controls, reconciliations, compliance coordination, and team management. The position requires a practical finance professional who can run day\-to\-day finance operations, review books, manage reporting timelines, coordinate with country\-level accountants and advisors, and present clear financial visibility to senior management.
