 Financial Control \& Management Reporting
 



 • Own financial control across all OnDemand International entities, ensuring accuracy,
 



 completeness, and integrity of books across multiple jurisdictions.
 



 • Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to the Managing Partner and
 



 leadership team.
 



 • Lead month\-end and year\-end closing activities across multiple entities.
 



 • Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, payables, expenses, and financial performance
 



 across the group.
 



 • Build and maintain reporting dashboards, MIS reports, and management accounts for leadership
 



 review.
 



 • Ensure internal approval workflows, payment controls, documentation, and reporting systems are
 



 properly followed.
 



 • Support the development and implementation of internal finance controls, reporting formats, and
 



 review mechanisms.
 



  





**Multi\-Country Finance Operations** 




 • Oversee finance operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other relevant
 



 jurisdictions.
 



 • Coordinate with local accountants, bookkeepers, auditors, tax advisors, and statutory agents in
 



 each country.
 



 • Ensure books are maintained in line with applicable country\-level accounting and reporting
 



 requirements.
 



 • Manage multi\-currency accounting, inter\-company transactions, reconciliations, and consolidated
 



 group\-level reporting.
 



 • Maintain financial records, entity\-wise reports, and country\-wise compliance trackers.
 



 • Ensure timely coordination for accounting updates, reporting deadlines, statutory filings, and
 



 management review requirements.
 



  





**Accounting \& Bookkeeping Oversight** 




 • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, payroll accounting,
 



 expense booking, invoicing, and general ledger maintenance.
 



 • Review journal entries, vendor payments, client invoices, expense claims, and reconciliations
 



 prepared by the accounting team.
 



 • Ensure proper chart of accounts, accounting structure, documentation, and reporting discipline
 



 across entities.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.
 



 • Ensure finance records are properly maintained and available for management review, external
 



 advisors, and audit coordination.
 



  





**Tax \& Compliance Coordination** 




 • Track direct and indirect tax\-related obligations across operating entities, including GST/VAT,
 



 corporation tax, withholding tax, payroll\-related statutory requirements, and other recurring
 



 filings.
 



 • Coordinate with external tax advisors and country\-specific consultants for filings, clarifications,
 



 documentation, and compliance updates.
 



 • Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure internal follow\-up so that deadlines are not missed.
 



 • Review tax and compliance information from an operational finance perspective before
 



 submission to external advisors.
 



 • Support management with visibility on upcoming compliance requirements, filing status, and
 



 pending action items.
 



  





**Team Management** 




 • Lead and manage a team of accountants, bookkeepers, and finance executives working across
 



 multiple entities.
 



 • Allocate responsibilities, review work quality, set reporting timelines, and ensure accountability
 



 within the finance team.
 



 • Act as the senior finance escalation point for internal teams and management.
 



 • Build systems, process notes, checklists, and documentation to reduce dependency on individuals
 



 and make the finance function scalable.
 



 • Train and guide team members to improve accuracy, reporting quality, and process discipline.
 



  





**Required Candidate Profile** 




**We are looking for candidates who have:** 




 • 8–10\+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, MIS, management reporting, and
 



 finance operations.
 



 • Strong academic foundation in commerce, accounting, and finance.
 



 • B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance background preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing books, reports, reconciliations, cash flow, payables, receivables,
 



 and management accounts.
 



 • Experience working with multi\-entity or multi\-country finance operations.
 



 • Ability to review the work of accountants and bookkeepers across different entities.
 



 • Strong understanding of financial reporting, consolidation, inter\-company transactions, and multi\-
 



 currency accounting.
 



 • Practical working knowledge of GST/VAT, tax coordination, statutory filing timelines, and
 



 compliance tracking.
 



 • Experience using accounting platforms such as Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, SAP, or
 



 similar systems.
 



 • Strong Excel, MIS, reporting, and financial analysis skills.
 



 • Ability to work directly with founders, senior management, and internal business teams.
 



 • Demonstrated continuity, ownership, and depth of experience in previous finance roles.
 



  





**Educational Preference** 




**Strong preference will be given to candidates with:** 




 • B.Com / M.Com / accounting\-based graduation.
 



 • MBA in Finance from a recognised institution.
 



 • Hands\-on finance operations and reporting experience in a company, group, consulting firm, or
 



 multi\-entity business environment.
 



  





 This role is best aligned with candidates who have practical experience in corporate finance operations, accounting management, MIS reporting, reconciliations, multi\-entity finance coordination, and management\-level financial reporting. Candidates from audit, taxation, advisory, or statutory compliance backgrounds are welcome to apply, provided they have practical experience managing in\-house finance operations, accounting teams, reporting cycles, reconciliations, and management reporting.
 



**Preferred Background** 




 • Prior experience in a corporate services firm, consulting company, international business group, or
 



 multi\-entity organisation.
 



 • Experience reporting directly to founders, directors, managing partners, or senior leadership.
 



 • Exposure to international accounting coordination across countries such as the UK, Europe,
 



 Australia, Singapore, or India.

 • Candidates with demonstrated ownership and meaningful tenure in previous finance roles will be

 • Must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led, multi\-entity business environment.

title: Business Finance Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We train India's next Allied Healthcare Professionals and we need someone who is a highly analytical and business\-oriented
 **Business Finance professional (Leadership Role) who treats each campus like their own company, not just a row in a spreadsheet and can drive financial performance through data\-driven insights and strategic decision\-making** 
 . This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. This is for someone who wants to be in the room where growth, admissions, and campus operations decisions are made; bringing the financial lens that turns good intentions into profitable outcomes.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Most finance people explain the P\&L after the quarter ends. We want someone who changes it before it does. If you've ever sat in a business meeting thinking "I could've told you that three weeks ago", this is your seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Run the numbers behind real campuses, enrollments, faculty costs, placements, profitability. Know them cold.
 



 ● Be in the room, not the report; sit with Business Heads and speak up before decisions are made, not just summarize them after.
 



 ● Chase the "why" behind the money; why did this channel's cost\-per\-enrollment spike? Why is one campus profitable and a near\-identical one isn't?
 



 ● Follow the cash all the way home from student loan approval to actual money in the bank.
 



 ● Build the model before anyone asks for it; forecasts, business cases, what\-ifs are rooted in real batch sizes and seat fill rates, not last year's numbers with 15% added on.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● 3 to 6 years in FP\&A or business finance; bonus if it's EdTech, healthtech, FinTech, or another fast\-moving, multi\-location business
 



 ● You've worked with business teams, not just for them
 



 ● Excel/Sheets fluent; SQL or BI tools a bonus
 



 ● You can explain a complex model in one sentence a non\-finance person gets instantly
 



 ● Curious by default; you ask "why" before you build the spreadsheet
 



 ● Confident enough to challenge a decision with data, even without authority over the room
 



  





**Bonus Points.** 




 ● CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA. Startup scars preferred over big\-company polish.
 



  





**Winning Looks Like** 




 ● Six months in, a Business Head calls you before making a big call, not after. And you can point to one real number you moved.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

title: Accounting Executive/POD and Invoice collection
description:
**Job Description:** 
 Accounting Executive/POD and Invoice collection – US Logistics Brokerage
 



  





**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounting; Reports To: Finance \& Compliance Manager / Accounting Supervisor
 



  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana —
 **Work From Office** 




  





**Shift:** 
 US Process (Night Shift, as per US business hours 6:30 pm\-3:30 am IST)
 



  





**Employment Type:** 
**Full\-Time;** 
 Compensation: ₹30,000 – ₹60,000 per month (commensurate with experience)
 



  





**About the Role:** 
 We are a US\-based logistics/freight brokerage looking to hire a detail\-oriented Accounting Executive for our back\-office finance team based out of Gurugram. This role sits at the intersection of freight operations and accounting — you will be responsible for POD (Proof of Delivery) management, carrier invoice processing and reconciliation, accessorial claims, and customer invoicing for US truckload/freight shipments. You will work closely with US\-based Operations, Carrier Sales, and Customer Service teams to ensure every shipment is billed accurately and on time.
 



 This is a high\-volume, process\-driven role. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on accuracy, doesn’t let details slip, and is comfortable following up relentlessly until an issue is closed.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or related field (B.Com/BBA preferred).
* Minimum 1 year of experience in freight brokerage, logistics/3PL back\-office, US accounting process, or transportation billing/invoicing.
* Familiarity with TMS platforms (e.g., McLeod, Turvo, Aljex, or similar) and billing portals such as Ascend is an advantage.
* Working understanding of US freight billing concepts — detention, layover, lumper, and other accessorial charges — or willingness to learn quickly.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy — this role requires a highly meticulous individual who can process high volumes of documentation and transactions without errors.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, for coordinating with US carriers, customers, and internal teams.
* Proficient in MS Excel; comfortable working with data/reports.
* Willingness to work night shifts aligned with US business hours, from our Gurugram office.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet daily/weekly deadlines, and work well under process\-driven timelines.



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**POD (Proof of Delivery) Management:** 



* Collect POD documents from carriers/drivers via email, portals, or carrier calls, and upload them accurately into the TMS (Transportation Management System) within defined turnaround times.
* Track and maintain the POD Reduction Report — identifying loads with missing, delayed, or incomplete PODs.
* Apply rate deductions/reductions for late POD submission as per company SOP, and present findings and trends in weekly team meetings.
* Ensure PODs are matched correctly against the Bill of Lading (BOL) and shipment/load number before filing.



  





**Carrier Invoice Processing \& Reconciliation:** 



* Upload carrier invoices into the TMS/accounting system and match them against agreed rates, rate confirmations, and load details (a form of three\-way match: BOL, POD, invoice).
* Identify billing discrepancies (rate mismatches, duplicate billing, unsupported accessorials, weight/quantity mismatches) and proactively communicate them to the sender (carrier/dispatcher) for correction.
* Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for every discrepancy raised and resolved.



  





**Accessorial Charges:** 



* Review, verify, and apply for all applicable accessorial charges, including detention, layover (LO), lumper fees, and other shipment\-related charges, with correct supporting documentation (timestamps, signed tickets, receipts, etc.).
* Validate that accessorial claims are within contractual/company guidelines before submission or approval.



  





**Open Loads \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Monitor and manage the open/unresolved loads queue; work daily with Operations, Carrier Sales, and Customer Service to close out pending load files.
* Chase down missing information (PODs, signed rate confirmations, accessorial backup, etc.) required to finalize billing, escalating aged items as needed.



  





**Documentation Compliance:** 



* Ensure that all documentation pertaining to a shipment — BOL, POD, rate confirmation, accessorial backup, and any exception/claim paperwork \- is complete, accurate, and properly filed in the TMS before a load is closed or billed.



  





**Customer Invoicing** 



* Generate and submit accurate, timely customer invoices via billing/invoicing portals such as Ascend (and other client\-specific portals as required).
* Ensure invoiced amounts reconcile with agreed customer rates, accessorials, and supporting shipment documentation before submission.
* Follow up on portal rejections or invoice queries raised by customers.



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare and present recurring reports (POD reduction, open loads aging, invoicing status) in internal review/weekly meetings. Flag recurring issues or process gaps to management for resolution.



  





**Key Competencies Attention to Detail** 



* catches discrepancies and errors others might miss Ownership \& Follow\-Through
* chases open items (loads, discrepancies, missing docs) to closure Organization \& Time Management
* handles high transaction volumes without backlog Cross\-Team Collaboration
* coordinates effectively with Ops, Carrier Sales, and Customer Service Process Discipline
* adheres consistently to documentation, billing, and compliance procedures Communication
* clear, professional communication with US\-based carriers and internal stakeholders



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* POD collection and TMS uploads consistently within SLA turnaround
* Minimal aged/open loads due to proactive daily follow\-up
* Carrier invoice discrepancies flagged and resolved quickly and accurately
* Accessorial claims (detention/LO/lumper) submitted correctly with full backup, first time
* Shipment files complete with no missing documentation at closeout
* Customer invoices submitted accurately and on time via Ascend/other portals
* Clear, data\-backed weekly reporting on POD reduction and open load trends



  





**Note:** 
 The above is representative of the core duties of this role and is not exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to add, modify, or remove duties and responsibilities at its discretion, based on business requirements.

**Job title**

 Finance and Accounts with responsibility for Trust and Foundation finance

 Finance Manager and Management
 



**Role focus** 
 Accurate accounting, timely compliance, controlled payments, reliable reporting and effective financial administration
 


 Role Purpose
 
 The Associate \- Finance is responsible for maintaining complete and accurate financial records, delivering dependable management information, meeting statutory and tax obligations, and supporting controlled banking and investment transactions. The role also manages the financial reporting, budgeting, compliance and documentation requirements of the organisation's trusts and foundations.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesAccounting Bookkeeping and Financial Reporting
 
 • Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date books of account, supporting schedules and financial records for all assigned entities.
 



 • Complete monthly and periodic account closures within agreed timelines, ensuring that entries, provisions and balances are properly supported.
 



 • Prepare monthly MIS reports covering financial performance, key movements and variance analysis for management review.
 



 • Support the preparation and finalisation of financial statements, including the balance sheet, statement of profit and loss and related schedules.
 



 • Reconcile ledgers and investigate discrepancies promptly so that reported balances remain reliable and audit\-ready.
 


 Direct and Indirect Taxation
 
 • Prepare and file applicable direct and indirect tax returns accurately and within statutory due dates.
 



 • Compute advance tax liabilities and provide timely inputs for payment and reporting decisions.
 



 • Own end\-to\-end GST compliance, including data preparation, return filing, reconciliations and follow\-up of exceptions.
 



 • Perform TDS calculations, deposits, return filings and ledger or certificate reconciliations.
 



 • Maintain complete working papers and compliance records to support audits, assessments and management review.
 


 Payments Banking and Investment Operations
 
 • Process approved vendor, statutory, investment and other payments accurately and on time, in accordance with authorisation controls.
 



 • Execute investment\-related transactions and maintain complete supporting documents, confirmations and transaction records.
 



 • Prepare bank reconciliations at the required frequency, minimise unresolved differences and close exceptions promptly.
 



 • Maintain appropriate control over banking access, transaction documentation and confidential financial information.
 



 • Identify and implement practical improvements or automation in payment and banking processes to reduce errors and processing time.
 


 Trust and Foundation Finance
 
 • Maintain complete books, schedules and financial records for trusts and foundations and support timely finalisation of their financial statements.
 



 • Manage trust\-related TDS, statutory records, supporting documents and recurring financial compliance requirements.
 



 • Maintain working knowledge of FCRA requirements and support compliant accounting, documentation and reporting wherever applicable.
 



 • Prepare donor financial reports and utilisation or fund\-based reports in the format and timelines agreed with stakeholders.
 



 • Support annual and periodic budgeting, financial analysis, cash monitoring and management reporting for trust activities.
 



 • Coordinate with auditors, consultants and internal stakeholders and provide accurate records and explanations for statutory and other reviews.
 


 Teamwork Process Support and Administration
 
 • Support the Finance Manager and other finance, office and trust team members with accurate and timely financial inputs.
 



 • Help improve the efficiency and consistency of finance and administrative processes, procedures and records.
 



 • Complete other finance\-related or administrative assignments requested by management within agreed timelines.
 



 • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, escalate material issues early and follow through until closure.
 



  





  





 Good Communication Skills essential .

title: Business Finance Analyst
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), consulting, or a related function.
* Experience executing full\-cycle FP\&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling within a multinational company setting.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Advanced proficiency in spreadsheets and SQL, and demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools/LLMs to automate workflows or enhance data analysis.
* Ability to take initiatives, navigate ambiguity and work in an unstructured environment.
* Distinctive problem\-solving skills with a proven track record of building complex financial models and identifying non\-obvious trends in large datasets.
* Excellent teamwork, communication and presentation skills; can craft and deliver a message with credibility to influence executive leadership.


**About The Job**
 Business Finance’s purpose is to create economic value for Google to fuel innovation. We balance the roles of trusted advisor and guardian to reveal opportunity, manage risk, and optimize investment. We establish a seat at the table and drive impact through a grounding in hard data, an independent point\-of\-view, a bias to action, a collaborative approach, and a focus on the development of our people.
   

  

 In this role, you will ensure that the company makes sound business decisions. As a Business Finance Analyst for the India market, you will be a strategic partner to the India leadership team, primarily focusing on Ads Sales and its supporting functions. Your work, from sophisticated financial modeling to tracking core performance metrics, will be the foundation upon which our leaders make critical strategic decisions.
   

  

 This role offers a unique vantage point into one of Google's most significant markets. You will not only manage the "rhythm of the business" (reporting, forecasting, and target setting) but also exercise thought leadership to shape the long\-term financial strategy and operational excellence of the India business.
   

  

 The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward\-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support India’s critical business finance operations for Large Customer Sales (LCS) Ads business such as business reporting, forecasting, target setting, analysis, and budget management.
* Provide management with insights and recommendations into drivers of business, market trends, risks, and opportunities leading to business enhancing and product actions.
* Engage in deep analyses to generate the insights and recommendations.
* Be a strategic enabler for our AI transformation, elevating the quality and scale of our deliverables while accelerating operational efficiencies.
* Act as a liaison to connect central Finance teams and the local teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Also be responsible for incorporating accurate data upload into Hyperion budgeting and forecasting tool as well as for the compilation, timely completion and submission of the Preliminary Budget Review Template and CEO Review Template to IMK.

 Innovation

**Knowledge**

* Analytical. Have key insights across market opportunities.
* Broad based commercial awareness to manage risk versus return trade\-offs.
* Understanding of all the commercial drivers impacting MasterCard’s business in the division (current and emerging product lines, services and programs)


 Communication \& Impact \& Influence

* Ensures that Finance is closely integrated with, and positively supports the business providing managers at all levels with the necessary information to make good business decisions; works with the management team in the development and implementation of short and medium term strategic and tactical plans and provide the financial input required to that process.


**Experience/Education**
 Bachelor's degree in accounting or MBA (CA/CPA/MBA Finance), finance or analysis with advanced knowledge and experience with all phases of financial planning and management.
   

  

 Good knowledge of Business Intelligence tools and experience with financial systems/applications (e.g. Hyperion and Oracle)
   

  

 Strong analytical and proven problem solving skills
   

  

 Self\-motivated with a proven track record of delivering success while operating in a team environment.
   

  

 Ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment with a sense of urgency and accuracy

 Excellent communication and presentation skills
   

  

 Broad understanding of all the different areas of finance
   

  

 Good understanding of reporting, forecasting and budgeting techniques.
   

  

 Strong strategic thinking and business understanding.
   

  

 Strong relationship management and networking skills.
   

  

**Key Success Factors Of The Role Holder**
* High intellect with good commercial acumen and a creative approach to problem solving.
* Good influencing skills, she/he must be able to communicate and present to the management team, she/he must also be persuasive with a considerate but firm touch.

 your work makes a difference.
   

  

 At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
   

  

 Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
   

  

 Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
   

  

**Essential duties and responsibilities**
* Coordinate closely with in\-country country business partners and finance teams to review projections, budgets and historical results.
* Load budget and forecast adjustments into system.
* Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the monthly reports, forecasts, and the annual budget / strategic plan preparation.
* Support the delivery of comprehensive monthly reporting packages for management, including monthly reviews of budget vs. actual results and variances with P\&L/cost center owner, etc.
* Partner with FP\&A Regional, Local, and Corporate resources within commercial and manufacturing/supply chain organizations to understand, drive and support decision making ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Coordinate escalation / identification of issues and advise Finance leadership of potential business and / or operational risks.
* Perform strategic ad hoc reporting and financial analysis to assess business performance and facilitate decision making and business support.
* Update process flows, operating manuals, training guides, and standard operating procedures, as needed.
* Support Finance leadership with process improvement, policy development, and / or strategic initiatives (e.g., business systems, processes, and / or policies).
* Liaise with the FP\&A Global Delivery Center (GDC) and other cross\-functional leads to support the creation of budgets, forecasts and management reports, while ensuring compliance with all quality / control requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field required.
* Demonstration of key finance competencies and qualifications and typically 5 \+ years of relevant experience with financial planning and reporting.
* Expert in technical and financial knowledge, including understanding of: internal control requirements and accounting principles as well as understanding of relevant business environment.
* Excellent analytical skills with familiarity with accounting, financial analysis and reporting.
* Excellent financial modeling skills preferred, experience in statistical modeling techniques is a plus.
* Experience with JD Edwards (JDE), Hyperion Planning, and Cognos preferred.
* Self\-starter with excellent analytical skills and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication and strong interpersonal skills.
* Expert in PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, often cross\-functionally.
* Ability and willingness to travel both domestically and internationally as required.
* English: Native or bilingual proficiency required.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations**
 Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Notice**

 Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

title: Asset Liability Manager
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Asset Liability Manager.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* To produce and review the Liquidity Risk reports for assigned geographies, which includes Internl Liquidity Metric, PRA 110, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) report, Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) report, Additional Monitoring Metrics (AMM) report, and other liquidity reports viz. Depositors Conc, Term Funding etc. The process involves liaising with various onshore team members over email and phone The role requires good understanding of (1\) financial products, (2\) market product specific knowledge and (3\) financial /management reporting (with balance sheet focus) (4\) Basel III framework
* To have a good understanding of systems viz. Cloud and FoTC
* To provide sites with various liquidity monitoring reports viz. Wholesale Mismatch Report, daily LCR etc
* To produce and review ALCO pack to assist Asset Liability Committee (ALCO) in decision making related to liquidity adequacy, capital adequacy, structural funding profile, Interest rate risk in banking book, transfer price policy etc
* Understand business requirements and interpret data to provide meaningful analysis to facilitate business decision\-making
* Analyze business performance and provide commentaries. Identify opportunities for development and drive changes independently
* Co\-ordinate, work\-closely with in\-country finance teams across the globe
* Performance Standards as defined in SLA met or exceeded.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Qualified CA (Chartered Accountant)/CWA /CPA /CFA/ MBA (Finance)/ PGDBM\-Finance with at least 8\+ years of post\-qualification experience or commerce graduates with at least 5\+ years of experience in accounting/financial reporting, management reporting, global consolidation, financial analysis within IFRS and IAS reporting framework
* Hands\-on experience of Liquidity or Regulatory reporting
* Deep understanding of Bank Balance Sheet, Strong attention to detail having strong analytical skills
* Good understanding of financial products and how they impact finance operations and more generically the banking business.
* Excellent working knowledge of MS related products i.e. Excel, Power Point, Access.
* Ability to develop effective working relationships with stakeholders of different seniority and geographical location.
* Excellent communication skills and presentation skills are mandatory, as are good tact and diplomacy, as the role requires relationship management with other individuals and teams within the HSBC Group
* Ideally, experience of leading and managing teams of between 2\-4 members or experience of being a senior/deputy within a team


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Senior Manager, Strategy - Franchise Strategy & Special Projects
description:
**Role Purpose**
 This role acts as a central Strategy bridge between the OU and the Integrated Operations function, helping translate Company and OU priorities into clear system implications, execution imperatives, and market\-level priorities.
   

  

 Working closely with Integrated Operations, the role brings strategic clarity, fact\-based challenge, and a consistent cross\-system lens to ensure OU priorities and growth opportunities are reflected in Bottling Partner planning and execution discussions. It also helps identify gaps, opportunities, and interventions across plans and performance to strengthen alignment and improve system execution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do For Us**
**Insights\-Led Strategy and Initiatives**
* Connect data, analytics, research, and consumer, customer, category, channel, competitive, and market insights to identify granular growth opportunities across channels, customers, and geographies.
* Translate insights into clear system implications, growth choices, and execution priorities for Integrated Operations and Bottling Partners.
* Use a fact\-based, hypothesis\-driven approach to challenge assumptions and sharpen local strategies.
* Identify, frame, and conduct preliminary evaluation of strategic initiatives that support OU priorities and system growth objectives.


**Strategic Projects**
* Actively contribute to select strategic projects linked to OU priorities, partnering with Integrated Operations teams and OU functions to bring structure, strategic clarity, and execution discipline to priority initiatives.
* Ensure disciplined project governance—clear objectives, success metrics, timelines, and accountability.


**Strategic Integration \& Execution**
* Act as a central Strategy partner connecting OU priorities, Integrated Operations plans, and Bottling Partner execution agendas.
* Translate Company and OU priorities into clear commercial and execution imperatives for Bottling Partners, ensuring consistency across markets while allowing for local context.
* Help translate global and Company “where to play” priorities into OU\-relevant implications, market\-level choices, and Bottling Partner execution priorities.
* Support Integrated Operations teams by bringing strategic clarity, fact\-based challenge, and an enterprise\-wide perspective into Bottling Partner planning discussions.
* Partner with Integrated Operations teams to calibrate and refine commercial execution strategies based on market realities, OU priorities, and Bottling Partner capabilities.
* Act as a thought partner to Integrated Operations Leads, bringing rigor, clarity, and pace to strategy development and priority initiatives.


**Performance Measurement \& Learning**
* Assess Bottling Partner performance against OU priorities, agreed business plans, and key strategic initiatives.
* Identify common performance patterns, execution gaps, risks, and scalable opportunities across Bottling Partners and markets.
* Objectively assess the impact of strategic initiatives, codifying what worked, what did not, and translating learnings into future strategies, planning processes, and execution priorities.
* Build mechanisms to network best practices, importing and exporting scalable ideas across markets and Bottling Partners.


**Enterprise Contribution**
* Contribute to business\-critical OU initiatives and leadership discussions through structured analysis, clear recommendations, a system lens, and execution rigor.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of progressive experience across Strategy, Growth, Insights, Planning, Commercial Strategy, Sales, or related business roles.
* Preferred experience in strategy consulting or equivalent strategy roles, with exposure to structured problem\-solving, hypothesis\-led analysis, stakeholder engagement, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong understanding of FMCG industry, with the ability to translate consumer, customer, channel, and market dynamics into actionable commercial strategies and execution priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, work effectively in cross\-functional teams, and contribute clear, fact\-based recommendations to senior business discussions.
* Experience working in complex, matrixed, and culturally diverse environments.
* Strong analytical orientation combined with practical, execution\-focused thinking.
* Experience using digital tools, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve analysis, generate insights, and enhance the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making.


**Success enablers**
* Strong ability to develop compelling, actionable consumer and commercial insights at market level.
* Ability to translate strategy into clear execution roadmaps, governance rhythms, and measurable commercial outcomes
* Ability to operate with a system and portfolio lens, connecting OU priorities, market realities, and Bottling Partner performance and commercial opportunities into clear strategic choices
* Ability to manage ambiguity and complexity while working with multiple cross\-functional stakeholders across the system.
* Ability to influence without authority in cross\-functional, matrixed, and Bottling Partner\-facing environments.
* Collaborative, inclusive, enterprise\-first mindset consistent with “Leadership in the Network.”


**Core Competencies And Skills**
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyze large datasets and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Structured approach to solving complex business challenges, informed by data and an intuitive understanding of “Future Back” and “Present Forward” perspectives.
* Foresight \& Innovation: Strong ability to anticipate short\- and long\-term business challenges, identify opportunities, and shape strategies for growth in competitive markets.
* Communication Excellence: Proficiency in storytelling through data\-driven presentations, conveying complex ideas with clarity, and customizing messaging for diverse audiences.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate across functions such as Marketing, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on initiatives
* Digital \& AI Fluency: Ability to use digital tools, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled applications to strengthen problem\-solving, insight generation, storytelling, and decision support.

title: Assistant Manager, Business Insights
description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Bill Gosling Outsourcing Corp.The Assistant Manager – Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.
* Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs.
* Diagnostics \& root\-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers.
* Analysis \& optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account — performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons — and translate findings into concrete optimization actions.
* Data \& analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs.
* Solution enablement \& implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground — coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed.
* Commercial \& account insight: Connect findings to account economics — productivity, cost\-to\-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client\-impact implications.
* Technology \& process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery.
* Adoption \& impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced.
* Reporting \& decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision\-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.


**Why Join Us?**
* Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and providing opportunities for career advancement.
* Comprehensive Training: We offer extensive paid training to ensure you’re equipped for success.
* Team\-Oriented Culture: Work in a collaborative, supportive environment with peers who are passionate about what they do.
* Diversity \& Inclusion: We celebrate the unique perspectives and contributions of all our employees.
* Fun Workplace: Join a vibrant team that knows how to have fun! From team engagement activities to social events, we foster a lively and inclusive work environment where you’ll build strong connections.
* State\-of\-the\-Art Offices: Work in our modern, well\-equipped offices designed to enhance collaboration and productivity.
* Rewarding Work: Help businesses grow while making a real difference in people’s lives!


**Get to Know Us Better!** 
 Follow us to get an insider view of our team in action, our values in motion, and a sneak peek into what makes us an awesome place to work!

* Partnering with senior leadership to shape strategic priorities, support high\-impact decision\-making, and provide data\-driven recommendations.

* A master’s degree from a reputed institute, along with 2 to 4 years of experience in managing a category within internet, e\-commerce, travel organizations, or in a similar role.



  





**Key Success factors for the role:** 



* Strong collaboration skills with a proven track record of working effectively across Product, Tech, Supply, Marketing, and Sales functions.
* Sharp analytical thinking with a passion for data\-driven problem solving and structured decision\-making.
* Ability to think strategically while maintaining a strong execution focus to drive measurable business outcomes.
* Experience in scaling category portfolios and leading innovation\-led growth initiatives.

* Agility to thrive in ambiguous environments, with a test\-and\-learn mindset and an iterative approach to driving performance improvements.

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 The JDE Finance Functional Consultant provides functional leadership and hands\-on support for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne financial processes. The role partners with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Tax, Project Controls and technical teams to sustain reliable transaction processing, period close, financial integrity and compliant change. The consultant combines strong accounting\-process knowledge with expert JDE configuration and troubleshooting capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 functional support for JDE EnterpriseOne financial modules and related integrations.
* Support General Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, cash or banking, allocations, multicurrency, tax and financial reporting processes based on assigned scope.
* Analyze posting, balancing, batch, voucher, invoice, receipt, payment and close issues; determine root cause and corrective action.
* Maintain and advise on financial configuration including companies, business units, object/subsidiary accounts, automatic accounting instructions, ledger types, document types, payment setup and period controls.
* Trace transactions from originating modules through account determination, batches and general ledger posting.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and develop functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Projects, Payroll, Tax and integration teams to manage cross\-module accounting impacts.
* Coordinate with JDE development and CNC/technical teams on reports, interfaces, batch jobs, custom applications, orchestrations and performance issues.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, regression and user acceptance testing with complete evidence and reconciliation.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close, releases, patches, upgrades, cutovers and post\-production stabilization.
* Assess application\-control and segregation\-of\-duties impacts for finance changes; support audit evidence and remediation.
* Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, knowledge articles, runbooks and user guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Finance functional experience.
* Deep experience in General Accounting plus at least two of the following: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Job Costing, cash/banking, multicurrency, tax or financial reporting.
* Strong understanding of accounting entries, subledger\-to\-ledger integration, reconciliations and period\-end processing.
* Hands\-on knowledge of JDE financial setup, processing options, versions, user\-defined codes, automatic accounting instructions and batch posting.
* Ability to analyze JDE tables, reports, batches and integrations to resolve complex production issues.
* Experience with JDE EnterpriseOne 9\.2 and modern UX or orchestration capabilities.
* Experience with requirements, functional specifications, testing, change management and support documentation.
* Exposure to banking interfaces, tax engines, consolidation, EPM and payroll integrations.
* Experience in a global, multi\-company and multicurrency environment.

title: Supervising Associate-Insights - Life Science
description:

**Job Listing: Supervising Associate \-**
**Job Listing Detail**
 At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**Domain Analyst**
**The opportunity**
 As a Domain Analyst at Supervising Associate rank at EY this role goes well beyond research delivery. You will specialize in key domain topics, contributing to EY's distinctive perspective on client issues to support commercial impact and business development. You will support specific programs within your area of expertise to drive the global or regional domain and specific accounts' growth ambitions. Working alongside the Domain Lead Analyst and/or Coordinating Analyst, you will deliver impactful analysis and insights for your domain and its activation with clients. Your role will involve providing analytical support and strategic advice on domain developments to EY leadership and sometimes clients, in your areas of specialism.

* Develop an internal brand to become recognized within EY as a subject matter expert in specific topic areas.
* Engage with senior domain stakeholders to provide commercial perspectives on the issues, challenges, and opportunities facing the domain and prepare insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients.

* Create commercial impact for EY by activating content with client servers across the EY network and proactively identifying opportunities for EY.
* Collaborate with domain stakeholders and EY colleagues across Insights and Clients and Industries to bring insights that support business development activities and service delivery to clients.
* Co\-create insights/PoV with EY SMEs with an audience\-first mindset and present them in a clear, compelling way.
* Proactively contribute your own ideas for insights for the domain, based on business priorities and an understanding of the domain's dynamics.
* Lead the creation of specific insights within areas of specialism by leveraging EY's proprietary knowledge and using data modelling and technology tools including AI while collaborating with Clients and Industries colleagues.
* Support the activation of specific external thought leadership across the EY network.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-domain collaboration and share insights with other Insights and Clients and Industries teams.
* Synthesize diverse perspectives and sources to develop compelling insights that drive results.
* Identify trends and translate them into key market\-facing initiatives for EY.
* Familiarize yourself with high\-quality sources of data in your domain and use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies to generate insights.

* Demonstrate high usage of advanced technological tools available for research.
* Demonstrated experience in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment.
* A self\-starter, able to bring new ideas for new insights to leadership.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively in a global, multi\-cultural environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* Ability to proactively build a network of internal and external contacts to shape insights.
* Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Adheres to key quality standards.


**What We Look For**
 University/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Master's degree or postgraduate qualification preferred.
   

  

* 5\-7 years' experience in strategy, business analysis, industry research, management consulting, or business performance, advising organizations in the relevant domain.
* May require occasional travel, both domestic and international.
* Proficient in English, both written and verbal.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we'll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

 Reporting \& Process Improvement
   

  




* Prepare procurement dashboards, spend analysis reports, and savings reports.
* Monitor procurement KPIs and identify opportunities for operational efficiency.
* Support digital procurement initiatives and ERP optimization projects.
* Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and controls.

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.

 **8–10 years of experience** 
 in procurement, sourcing, commercial management, or cost management.

title: Senior Team Manager – Energy & Industrials, Expert Content
description:
Position summary
   

  

 The Senior Team Manager leads the Energy \& Industrials Expert Content team and is accountable for its portfolio direction, research quality, talent development and delivery. The role converts market and client demand into coverage priorities, assigns topic ownership across sub\-sector and asset\-class subject matter experts, manages capacity, and develops the team’s sector expertise, ideation, research judgment and interviewing capabilities.
   

  

 The role requires deep knowledge of Energy \& Industrials, working knowledge of adjacent sectors, a broad understanding of relevant asset classes and strong investor\-oriented judgment. The Senior Team Manager interprets earnings calls, management commentary, analyst questions and market developments; connects insights across the team’s work; and uses that perspective to originate differentiated research concepts, synthesis products and selected expert conversations.
   

  

 Location: Gurugram, India
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Coverage strategy and prioritization
   

  

* Set and maintain the coverage roadmap for the Energy \& Industrials team, including priority coverage areas, companies, themes, recurring programs and known gaps.
* Translate global Expert Content strategy and priorities, content viewership and usage trends, client and Sales feedback, regional demand and market developments into coverage priorities, format choices, capacity decisions and an appropriate geographic balance across APAC, the United States and other priority markets.
* Identify cross\-company themes, divergent views, emerging risks and content gaps, connecting macro and sector developments to company\-level and investment implications.
* Challenge the team to pursue original angles beyond familiar companies, topics and approaches, and determine primary and supporting ownership when sub\-sector, asset\-class, geographic or thematic expertise overlaps.


 Team leadership and capability building
   

  

* Lead, coach and performance\-manage the team’s sub\-sector and asset\-class subject matter experts, and provide research direction and quality calibration for Associates supporting the team.
* Assign ownership of individual topics and manage work queues, capacity, delivery cadence and escalations across the team.
* Lead regular sector discussions that surface new signals, test interpretations, generate content ideas and build the team’s collective expertise.
* Review research plans, expert profiles, interview questions and completed transcripts; observe selected interviews; and coach research approach, sector judgment and interviewing technique.
* Build a shared understanding of quality, insight and investor value through transcript calibration, direct feedback and structured coaching that strengthen execution and judgment across the team’s subject matter experts (SMEs).


 Research innovation, synthesis and quality
   

  

* Originate differentiated research concepts, conversation structures, recurring series and synthesis formats; work with relevant internal partners to turn viable ideas into clear research objectives, required expert perspectives and execution plans.
* Produce and review sector\-level and thematic research that connects insights across multiple expert interviews, companies and perspectives, presenting a more comprehensive view of what the collective evidence may indicate without making investment recommendations.
* Use AI tools and effective prompts to accelerate synthesis and drafting while independently validating the underlying evidence, adding context and strengthening the final analysis.
* Personally conduct or moderate selected high\-value expert conversations where senior sector experience can materially improve the depth, originality or integration of the insights generated.
* Set standards for expert fit, question design, interview execution and research quality; coach interviewers to listen actively, adapt beyond prepared questions and pursue valuable unanticipated lines of inquiry.
* Use performance data and recurring quality or workflow issues to identify coverage gaps, guide coaching and improve research practices, templates and processes; ensure recurring insights and effective research approaches are documented and applied across future coverage, and that all work meets established quality, confidentiality and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10–13 years of relevant experience in buy\-side investment research, equity or credit research, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, transaction advisory or a comparable research leadership role.
* Demonstrated depth within Energy \& Industrials, including its major industries and value chains, combined with working knowledge of adjacent sectors, relevant asset classes and broader market dynamics.
* Experience serving institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience, with a strong understanding of how investors frame decisions and uncertainty.
* Ability to synthesize earnings calls, market developments and primary research into themes, risks, differentiated research concepts and decision\-useful outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to originate differentiated research concepts; translate them into clear objectives, expert profiles and interview structures; and frame incisive, investor\-relevant questions.
* People leadership and coaching experience, including facilitating thoughtful team discussion and strengthening SMEs’ research judgment, capabilities and performance.
* Credible live\-interviewing capability and the ability to coach others in active listening, probing, real\-time adaptation and moderation technique.
* Strong written and verbal English, research judgment and operating discipline to convert strategy into priorities, quality controls and measurable delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and valuation context sufficient to evaluate investor\-relevant research across Energy \& Industrials.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the curiosity and discipline to maintain deep sector expertise and relevant cross\-sector and asset\-class awareness.
* Comfort using AI\-enabled research tools and developing effective prompts to accelerate synthesis, drafting and workflow without substituting for human judgment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A track record of establishing or scaling research teams, coverage models, quality standards, training programs or knowledge repositories.
* Experience integrating equity, credit, private\-market or other relevant investor perspectives into sector research.
* Experience in expert networks or scaled primary research; MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant advanced qualification.

Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

CPP is responsible for global stewardship of the Company’s core product offerings including strategy, product design and value propositions for debit, credit and prepaid as well as management of Cardholder Solutions, Digital Solutions, Global Processing and Prepaid Management. * Partner with Product and Product Finance to review and prioritize various investments to achieve sustainable business growth.
* Support efforts to develop net revenues and profitability for Product categories.
* Support effective cost management and efficiency efforts.


**All About You**

* Advanced modeling and analytical skills (both quantitative and qualitative)

* Excellent project management, follow up and organizational skills.
* Strong prioritization skills to balance multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential information and materials with appropriate discretion.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable interacting with all levels of management
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or related discipline, Chartered Accountant or MBA (preferably in Finance/General Management)

title: Category Manager
description:
**MERCHANDISING MANAGER \- HOME** 




 Function: Merchandising \| Location: New Delhi (Tulsi Farms) \| Reporting to: Chief Merchandising Officer
 



 Experience: 6\-9 years in Merchandising (minimum 3 years handling the Home category)
 



**Step Into the World of Nicobar** 




 Founded in 2016 by Simran Lal and Raul Rai,
 **Nicobar** 
 is a modern, mindful, design\-led lifestyle brand from India.
 



*“We wanted to create a new Indian sensibility that wasn’t necessarily Westernised.”* 




 We’re reimagining a contemporary Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world—rooted in culture, shaped by design, and guided by intention. At Nicobar, we believe in culture as much as commerce, and that how we build is just as important as what we build.
 



 Our studio is tucked away in Tulsi Farms, Chhatarpur, Delhi. Nestled among trees, seasonal gardens, a citrus grove, and our beloved dogs Nico \& Dot, we call it
 *“
 
 the Treehouse.
 
 ”* 
 It earned its name when our architect reworked the blueprint to protect every single tree on the land. It’s a space where creativity brims and energy flows.
 



 If you’re drawn to thoughtful design, a youthful and nourishing team culture, and the chance to grow a brand with heart—we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Follow our journey:** 

 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 
 \|
 
 Nicobar.com
 
 \|
 **Watch our Co\-founders, Raul \& Simran talking about Nicobar**




**Reach out to us through the below link \-** 
 📩
 **https://lnkd.in/gghFi5Yz**




**Your Role in the Story** 




 You are the commercial engine behind Nicobar’s Home category – owning the numbers, the range, and the results across tableware, drinkware, textiles, décor, and furniture. Reporting to the CMO, you sit at the intersection of data and intuition, analysing what is selling, anticipating what should, and working across planning, design, sourcing, and retail to keep the category commercially sharp season after season.
 



**Where You’ll Make Impact** 



* Own the commercial performance of Home – sell\-throughs, best and worst sellers, markdowns, and replenishment against seasonal targets.
* Drive the Home range plan with design and sourcing – balanced, seasonally relevant, and aligned to pricing architecture and occasion (everyday, entertaining, gifting, festive).
* Manage width, depth, and open\-to\-buy – balancing core replenishable lines against seasonal drops, and keeping inventory and stock cover healthy.
* Build the seasonal buy and forecast – size and phase orders by channel, set OTB by sub\-category, and manage in\-season re\-orders to protect margin.
* Own markdown, ageing, and terminal\-stock strategy – act early on slow sellers, plan exit routes, and keep provision and liquidation under control.
* Ensure on\-time launches across channels, flagging critical\-path risks early enough to course\-correct.
* Set pricing and margin architecture for the category – benchmark against competitors, protect intake and realised margins, and guide sourcing on cost targets.
* Partner with the design team on newness and hero products – translate commercial signals into clear briefs for gifting, festive, and collection drops.
* Shop the market and competitors – identify white spaces and bring sharp, well\-evidenced range recommendations.
* Drive category expansion – spot adjacent sub\-categories and gaps in tableware, textiles, décor, and gifting, and build the case to enter them.
* Partner with VM and retail so the Home story is told well in\-store and online, and build reports and dashboards that turn numbers into decisions.



**What You Bring Along** 



* 5–8 years in fashion, home, or lifestyle merchandising, with a minimum of 3 years handling the Home category.
* Very strong analytical ability, including proficient, hands\-on command of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Fluent with AI and digital tools, and quick to apply them – turning technology into sharper planning, cleaner communication, and building efficient dashboards and workflows.
* You understand what makes Home aesthetically and commercially different – sub\-categories with distinct end uses, buying rhythms and margin logic.
* Strong cross\-functional skills with design, sourcing, planning, VM, and retail, and disciplined follow\-through across multiple drops.



**The Nicobar Spark** 



* A natural problem\-solver – you break messy, ambiguous situations into clear parts, and you'd rather bring a solution than escalate a problem.
* Strong stakeholder management – you build trust quickly across design, sourcing, planning, and retail, and you know how to influence without authority.
* A clear communicator – you turn numbers into a story people can act on, whether you're in a leadership review or a design huddle.
* Calm under pressure – drops, deadlines, and last\-minute changes don't rattle you; you re\-prioritise and keep the critical path moving.
* Detail\-obsessed without losing the big picture – you sweat the SKU\-level numbers but never lose sight of the season and the brand.
* A builder, not just a doer – you leave behind better templates, cleaner reports, and sharper ways of working than you found.
* Genuinely collaborative – you share credit, ask good questions, and make the people around you better.
* Commercially curious – you keep asking "why" behind the numbers and "what next" for the category.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**About Zippee**
* Zippee is building India’s \#1 Quick Commerce Logistics for consumer brands.
* Brands connect their online store to Zippee in just a few clicks \& can kickstart 30\-Min Delivery/120\-Min/Same\-Day Delivery for customers through our dark store network across India.

* Zippee is seeking talented Financial Analyst for reporting, revenue and cost analysis, budgeting, and profitability tracking.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Track and prepare monthly MIS reports.
* Monitor the profitability of Zippee dark stores and identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare budgets for all departments and track actual expenses against budgets.
